The monster presence has faded from around us.
Prince, your command was splendid even without the Heavy Armor.
m920080.嘆きは死後に取っておくが良い、人間たちよ。\nさあ、女神アダマスを解放せんと望む: Save your lamentations for after death, humans. Now, if you wish to free the goddess Adamas, gamble on a one-in-ten-thousand chance and try to defeat me.
m920080.地上界は絶望的といっても過言ではありません……。\n今や、アイギス姉さまも私も、: It's no exaggeration to say the mortal realm is in utter despair… Now both Sister Aigis and I have lost most of our power…
m920080.報告！\nゴブリン軍、退却していきます！: Report! The goblin forces are retreating!
m920080.女神が女神を、封印した……だとッ！？\n馬鹿な……！: A goddess sealing a goddess… what!? That's absurd…!
m920080.女神アダマス様の封印……。\nそれがこの迷宮にあるという事が分かったのです。: The seal of Goddess Adamas… We've discovered that it's located within this maze.
m920080.姉様……どうしてこの様な仕打ちをなさるのですか……。\nどうか目をお覚まし下さい: Sister… why would you do something like this? Please awaken, sister… It's not too late yet… not yet…
m920080.姉様……未だにその様な事をお考えなのですか！？\nやはり今度こそ私の神器によって: Sister… you're still thinking that way!? As I thought, this time I must cut that evil heart out, together with you, using my divine weapon.
m920080.封印を解いたのは私です。\n滅び行く人間達の無残な姿を、\n我が愚妹アイギスとア: I was the one who broke the seal, to show the doomed humans the pitiful sight of my foolish sister Aegis and Adamas.
m920080.帝国軍の総力を決して迷宮の調査に挑んだのですが、\n全ての部隊が迷宮から戻る事は: The imperial forces have thrown all their might into exploring the maze, yet no unit has ever returned, and the Emperor himself is now going out to lead the charge…
m920080.帰ったら帝国軍との連絡手段や、\n様々な取り決めもしなくてはいけないですし、\n: Once we get back, we'll have to arrange communications with the Imperial army and handle various agreements, so it'll be busy for a while, Prince!
m920080.役に立てなくてすまなかった王子。\nいつもより入念に鎧を磨いていたというのに……:
I'm sorry I couldn't be of use, Prince.
I even polished my armor more thoroughly than usual…
sigh.
m920080.彼らは陛下のご側近。\n陛下もご無事に違いない！:
They are His Majesty's close aides.
His Majesty must be safe as well!
m920080.恐ろしい魔物が、次々と我らの心を支配していったのだ。\n早く……早くしなければ、:
Terrible monsters have been possessing our minds one after another.
If we don't act quickly…
Eventually even His Majesty's will will…!
m920080.悪かったよディルク。そんなに真剣になるな。\n言葉のあやだぜ。\nそれに、ディル: My bad, Dirk. Don't take it so seriously. It's just words. Besides, I get where you're coming from.
m920080.悪霊……ですか……。\n王子、今回の遠征では、部隊の編成に\n充分注意をお願いし: Evil spirits…? Prince, please be extra careful with the unit composition on this expedition.
m920080.悪霊の仕業……かもね。\nこの迷宮では、古くから冒険者を苦しめる不可思議な\n現:
Probably the work of evil spirits.
This maze has long been said to cause mysterious phenomena that torment adventurers.
m920080.愚かで不浄なる人間達を滅ぼす事に、\n何をためらう必要があるというのです、アダマ: What reason is there to hesitate in wiping out the foolish, impure humans, Adamas? I'm bored… I'll go now.
m920080.我々、魔族の復活カラ早３年余リデアル……。\nまさか、ワタクシの頭脳ヲこれ程使ワ: We've been reviving demons for over three years now… Never imagined a human could make such use of my intellect… It's beyond anything I expected!
m920080.我が国において、最強の戦士だからこそ、\n陛下は皇帝たりえたのです。: Because I'm the strongest warrior in our land, I was able to become Emperor.
m920080.我が帝国の軍師様は皇帝が戻られぬ事で、\nかなり狼狽えておられました……。\n私: Our empire's strategist was in a panic over the Emperor's disappearance… All troops except me probably went deeper into the labyrinth to search for him…
m920080.我が神器を受け継ぎし者よ。: He who inherits my divine weapon.
m920080.戦場で先頭に立ち、\n他の誰よりも命をかけて帝国を守るそのお姿に、\n我ら兵や民: Standing at the front lines, risking my life more than anyone else to protect the Empire—that's why the soldiers and the people follow us!
m920080.数多くの冒険者がこの迷宮で行方不明と\nなっている事を知らない訳ではないだろう？: You must know that many adventurers have gone missing in this maze, right? Dirk.
m920080.早速魔物が現れたか。\nこの金色の鎧で敵の注目を一手に引き付け――\nん……変だ:
So the monsters showed up right away.
This golden armor draws all the enemy's attention—
Hmm… weird… the armor feels suddenly heavy…
m920080.汚らわしい貴方達の相手は、我が僕に任せるとしましょう。\nさぁ、姿を現しなさい…: Leave the filthy ones to my servant. Come forth, my loyal darkness embodied… Demon King!
m920080.無事では……ないわ。\nひどく、心が傷ついたもの。: Safe…? Not really. My heart is terribly wounded.
m920080.無様な敗者の背を斬る趣味は持ち合わせていない。\n好きにさせろ。: I have no taste for cutting down the backs of pitiful losers. Let them go their own way.
m920080.狼狽える必要はない。\n今ここに、二柱の神の加護があるという事を忘れるな。: There's no need to panic. Remember, the blessings of the two great gods are with us here and now.
m920080.王子……。魔の花嫁となる宿命から、\n私を救って頂いた事は忘れていません。: Prince… I haven't forgotten how you saved me from the fate of becoming the demon's bride.
m920080.王子、『ヘビーアーマー』の皆さんは、\n戦いに出る事が出来ません！\n慎重な采配:
Prince, the Heavy Armor members can't go into battle!
Please command carefully.
m920080.王子、アダマス様に続き、\n一刻も早くケラウノス様を追いかけましょう！: Prince, after Adamas, we must pursue Keraunos without delay!
m920080.王子、急ぎましょう！\n皇帝はこの先にいるようです！:
Prince, let's hurry!
The Emperor is ahead!
m920080.王子、急ぎ迎撃の準備を！\nドルカさん、アリサさんは、後ろへ！\n治癒術の準備を: Prince, prepare to intercept immediately! Dorca, Alissa—fall back! Please ready your healing spells!
m920080.王子、魔王とケラウノスが退いていきます！: Prince, the Demon King and Keraunos are retreating!
m920080.王子メ、\nお前の力が勝ツカ、ワタクシの頭脳が勝ツカ、\nイズレ必ず決着をつける: Prince, whether it's your strength or my intellect, one of us will win, and we'll finally settle this!
m920080.王子！ ケラウノスの姿を見つけたわ！\nあたしの矢で足止めするわっ！\nはァ――: Prince! I've spotted Keraunos! I'll pin him down with my arrow! Haa—!!
m920080.生物として雄であれば何者であろうと魅了する\n妾のフェロモンにも抗い続けるとは…:
If a male creature resists my pheromones, no matter who he is… fuf.
The Empire's Emperor… I look forward to the day you fall.
m920080.皆さん、そろそろ先に進みましょう。\nここは、まだまだ迷宮の入口付近です。\n急: Everyone, let's move forward. We're still near the entrance of the labyrinth. Hurry up!
m920080.神を裏切ってしまった罪は\n消えはしないのですよね……。\n王子と共に歩めば、い: The sin of betraying a god never fades… But I believe that walking with you, Prince, will one day atone for it.
m920080.神器を受け継ぎし者を一掃する機会を窺っていたのですよ。\n空の上では、逃げること: I've been biding my time, waiting for the chance to wipe out those who inherit the divine relics. Up there in the sky you can't even flee… …Now, Demon King, the moment of incarnation has arrived!
m920080.笑わせないで、アダマス。\nあなたの神器も、その使い手も、\n今や我が手中にあり: Don't make me laugh, Adamas. Your divine weapon and its wielder are now in my hands.
m920080.簡単な事ですよ……ふふ。\nこの壺に、アダマスを封じたのは\n他ならぬ私なのです: It's simple… Heh. I'm the one who sealed Adamas in that jar.
m920080.考えたくはないですが、\nやはり、ケラウノスに与する魔物が\n他にもいるというこ:
I don't want to think about it, but
it seems there are other monsters serving Keraunos….
m920080.自らの力で封印を解いたと信じているのですね。\n本当に、自惚れの強い人間達……。: You believe you broke the seal with your own strength. How arrogant, truly…
m920080.良かった……何とか魔物を退けられたようですね。: That's a relief… It looks like we managed to drive the monster away.
m920080.良かった！ どうやら正気を取り戻したようですね。: Good! It seems you've regained your senses.
m920080.調査の為に迷宮に入った者達も戻ってこず、\n原因も分からないまま……。そして、い:
Those who entered to investigate never came back, and no one knows why…
Over time, people began to say that evil spirits now dwell here.
m920080.陛下……？ そ、そうだった！\nこの先に、陛下が捕らえられているのだ……！\n早:
His Majesty…? I-it's true!
Further ahead, His Majesty is being held…!
Hurry to his side!
m920080.陛下ッ！！\nしっかりしてください！ 私がお分かりになりますか？:
Your Highness!!
Stay with us! Can you hear me?
m920080.騎士殿、私は白の帝国の兵士ディルクと申します。\n陛下はご一緒ではないのでしょう:
Knight, I am Dirk, a soldier of the White Empire.
Is His Majesty not with you?
m920080.魔王がケラウノス様の僕！？\n神様は私たち人間を\n本当に滅ぼそうとしているとい: The Demon King is Keraunos' servant?! Is the deity truly trying to annihilate us humans…?!
m920080.黙れ……貴様らの様な愚物に、屈するものか……。: Silence… I will never bow to fools like you….
m920080.（あの刻より千年……。\nまさか、あの苛烈な戦いよりも、\n厳しい状況になるなん:
(Since that moment a thousand years ago…
Who would have thought the situation would become harsher than that fierce battle…)
m920080.（ですが、今はわずかな希望に全てを託す他ありま\nせん……。アイギス姉様の信徒と: (But now we have no choice but to place all our hopes in that slight chance… I earnestly wish that the followers of Sister Aegis and my own followers can join hands to reclaim the surface world…)

m920153.――あーあ、この吹雪じゃ、\nクリスマスパーティも台なしですわね……。:
――Ah, this blizzard is going to ruin
the Christmas party, isn't it……
m920153.――い、いや、あれを見ろ！\nあの軍旗、王国の主力部隊のものだぞ！！:
—N-No, look at that!
That banner! It belongs to the Kingdom's main force!!
m920153.――いいえ、今の私はサンタヘイオス！\n子どもたちの夢を守るために戦う騎士ですと:
—No, I am Santa Heios right now!
I am a knight who fights to protect the dreams of children!
m920153.――えぇっ！？\nクリスマスって楽しいお祭りじゃないの！？:
――Eh!?
Isn't Christmas supposed to be a fun festival!?
m920153.――えぇと、これが要塞化された館ですか。\n周囲にデーモンや罠が山程配置されてい:
――Well, so this is the fortified mansion.
There are mountains of demons and traps set up all around…
m920153.――くっ、西門が突破されたぞ！\nこいつら本当に盗賊なのか！？:
—Gah! The west gate has been breached!
Are these guys really just bandits?!
m920153.――こっちに王国軍が来ているぞ！: —The kingdom's army is coming this way!
m920153.――さぁパーシス！ いっくわよ～！！\n雪玉どかーん！！ どかーん！！:
――Come on, Percis! Here I come~!!
Snowball, boom!! Boom!!
m920153.――ちっ、フォーの奴め、\nこちらの仕事は手伝わないくせに、\nこういう時だけ助:
Tch, that Four...
He never helps with our work,
yet he only asks for a hand when it suits him.
m920153.――っと、その前に。\n王子殿下にはもうひとつ、\n予行演習に付き合ってもらわな:
――Oh, before that.
There is one more thing, Your Highness.
I need you to join me in a rehearsal.
m920153.――ですが、重要な証拠を手に入れました。\n王子、この手紙を。:
――However, we did secure some crucial evidence.
Prince, please take this letter.
m920153.――というわけで、今年は私も、\nサンタクロースの一族のお手伝いとして、\nプレ:
――So, this year, I've been assigned to help
 the Santa Claus clan
 with gift distribution.
m920153.――また王国、また王子か。\nこんな小さな犯罪組織相手に、\n国の長が出てくると:
――The Kingdom again, and the Prince, no less.
What a grand reception for a petty criminal outfit like ours.
m920153.――ん、あれは……。\n気をつけろ！ 侵入者だ！！:
――Hm, what is that…
Watch out! Intruders!!
m920153.――ん、なんだ？\nこの辺り、やけに静かだな……。:
――Hm, what is that?
It's unnaturally quiet around here…….
m920153.――クリスマス爆破計画。\n次なる段階は、雪の国の襲撃。:
――The Christmas Bombing Plan.
The next phase is an assault on the Snow Country.
m920153.――クリスマス破壊計画、ですか。: ――A plan to destroy Christmas, you say.
m920153.――コーネリア、いきなり呼び出したりして、\nいったいどうしたのですか？:
――Cornelia, why did you summon me so suddenly?
 What's going on?
m920153.――フォー人形を子どもたちに贈る、\nそれが本当の狙いだったということですね。:
—Giving Fo's dolls to the children.
That was the true objective.
m920153.――勘違いしてもらっちゃ困るなァ……。\n誰が愉しいだけで人を殺すっていうんだい:
—I'm afraid you're mistaken…
Who said I kill people just for fun?
m920153.――口を割らないその気概は認めよう。\nだが、サンタからの贈り物を奪うことが、\:
――I'll give you credit for your silence.
But is stealing Santa's gift really more important
than your life?
m920153.――子どもたちはサンタからのプレゼントを待っている。\nそれなのに、ただのコーネ:
――The children are waiting for presents from Santa.
If I just delivered them as plain Cornelia,
they wouldn't be from Santa; they'd be from me.
m920153.――悪夢のような光景ね。\nおもちゃの生産ラインが、\n全部フォーの人形に入れ替:
—What a nightmare.
The entire toy production line
has been replaced with Fo's dolls!
m920153.――王子、ご報告を。\nフォーは完全に足取りを消し、\n闇の組織内部でも消息不明:
—Prince, I have a report.
Fo has completely vanished from our tracking,
and he's listed as missing even within the dark organization.
m920153.――王子、気をつけてください。\n周囲に姿を隠しているアサシンがいます。:
――Prince, be careful.
There are assassins hiding nearby.
m920153.――王子殿下！ 大変です！ 大事件です！！: ――Your Highness! This is serious! Something major has happened!!
m920153.――王子殿下！ 失礼します！\n……っと、おや？ おひとりですか？:
—Your Highness! Pardon the intrusion!
…Oh, my? Are you alone?
m920153.――罠、ですか。\nみなさん、周辺に警戒を。\nこの吹雪では視界が上手く通りませ:
――It's a trap.
Everyone, stay alert!
The blizzard is making it hard to see.
m920153.――荒くれ者の互助組織だった闇ギルドに対し、\n闇の組織は幹部連中の強権による、:
—Whereas the Dark Guild was a mutual-aid society for roughnecks,
the Dark Organization has transformed into a structured criminal syndicate
ruled by the iron fist of its executives.
m920153.――警備を厚くしてはみましたが……。\nなかなか犯人はしっぽを見せませんね。:
――I've reinforced the security, but…….
The culprit isn't showing their tail yet.
m920153.……あ、あれ？ あれ？\n皆戦闘準備を始めてしまいましたよ！？:
……Ah, what? What?
Everyone has started getting into combat stances!
m920153.……ああ。ナインの兄貴が殺されて、\nその後はずっと、幹部のフォーさんの下で、\:
……Yes. After Brother Nine was killed,
I was forced to work under the executive, Four,
and I only ever had brutal jobs assigned to me…….
m920153.……あっ、あぁぁぁっ！！\nよわよわ王子、大変だよ！ 大変なの！！:
…Ah, aaah!!
Weakling Prince, this is bad! It's really bad!!
m920153.……あっ、行ってしまいました。\nこんなに可愛いのに、不器用な人ですよね。:
……Ah, she's gone.
She's so clumsy, despite being so cute.
m920153.……いや、周辺には民家もある。\nだが生活音ひとつしないということは――:
……No, there are houses nearby.
But not a single sound of daily life means――
m920153.……うぅん、これは違います。\n自爆したのは人形で、細い魔力の糸が繋がっています:
…Hmm, that's not quite right.
It was the doll that exploded. There's a thin thread of mana connected to it.
m920153.……お前、闇ギルドの残党か。\nナインの部下だったな、確か。:
……So you're a remnant of the Dark Guild.
You were Nine's subordinate, if I recall.
m920153.……このフォーも、人形だったようですね。: ……It seems this Fo was just a doll as well.
m920153.……そ、それだけだっ！\n二度とは説明しないからな！:
……T-That's all there is to it!
I'm not explaining it again!
m920153.……その判断は私がする。\n情報を全て吐けば、悪いようにはしないぞ。:
……I'll make that judgment.
If you tell us everything, I won't harm you.
m920153.……ところで、ふたりともどうして、\nサンタって名前にこだわっているのですか？:
……By the way, why are you both
so insistent on the name "Santa"?
m920153.……なるほど、クリスマス爆破作戦とは、\nふざけた企みだと思っていたが――:
…I see. The Christmas Bombing Operation…
I thought it was a ridiculous scheme, but—
m920153.……なるほど。\nそれでヘイオス、どうして私たちまで\nここに集められたのだろう:
……I see.
 Then, Heios, why were we all
 gathered here...?
m920153.……なんだ、闇ギルドを懐かしんでいるのか？: ...So, do you miss the Dark Guild?
m920153.……はい？\nあの、どこからどう見てもコーネリアでは？:
……Pardon?
 But from where I'm standing, you look exactly like Cornelia?
m920153.……はっ、そ、そうですよ！\n生産ラインはここだけじゃないんです！！:
…Hah, y-yes!
There are other production lines besides this one!!
m920153.……へぇ、子どもの夢と未来？\n俺も同意見だよサンタの淑女諸君。:
……Hmm, the dreams and future of children?
I'm on the same page with you, ladies of the Santa corps.
m920153.……ぼ、ボクと、一緒に\nおいしいごはんを食べにいきませんか！？:
…W-Will you go eat
some delicious food with me?
m920153.……やっぱり、クリスマスは\nこうじゃないといけませんね。:
……After all, that is
how Christmas should be.
m920153.……ん、サンタヘイオス、外を見てみろ。\n吹雪が止みはじめたぞ。:
……Hm, Santa Heios, look outside.
The blizzard is starting to clear.
m920153.……コーネリア、いえ、サンタコーネリア。\nどうやら話は通じないようです。:
……Cornelia, I mean, Santa Cornelia.
It seems we're not getting through to him.
m920153.……サンタの特権、というやつかな。\nともあれ、今年のクリスマスは\n何事もなく:
……It's a Santa's privilege, I guess.
Anyway, I hope this year's Christmas
passes without a hitch.
m920153.……サンタは、子どもたちに夢を運ぶもの。\nだからこそ、夢の守護者は強くなくては:
……A Santa delivers dreams to children.
 That is why a guardian of dreams must be strong.
 That's what you mean, right, Santa Cornelia?
m920153.……テティスさん、何を吹き込んだんですか？: ……Thetis, what did you whisper to her?
m920153.……フォーという男が、話に聞いたとおりなら、\nその行動原理を理解しようとは\n:
……If this Four is as they say,
it's probably best not to try
to understand his motives.
m920153.……フォーの行動原理は、\n闇の組織とは相容れないのです。:
…Fo's motives are
incompatible with the Dark Organization's.
m920153.……プレゼントを強奪するなんて、\n愉快犯にしても卑劣にすぎます。\n絶対に犯人:
……Robbing children of their presents is despicable, even for a thrill-seeker.
 We absolutely must catch the culprit...
m920153.……ヘイオスったら、誰より先に\n王子に渡したかっただけなんじゃ……。\nいえ、:
……Heios, you just wanted to give it to the Prince
before anyone else, didn't you…….
No, silence is golden, I suppose.
m920153.……今後も調査を継続します。\n進展があり次第、再びご報告を。:
…We will continue the investigation.
I will report back to you as soon as there is any progress.
m920153.……承知しました。\n王子、あのフォーは人形よりも手練です。ご注意を。:
……Understood.
Prince, that Fo is a far more skilled fighter than the dolls. Please be careful.
m920153.……見つかってしまいましたか。\n王子殿下、敵の抵抗が激しくなると思われます。\:
……It seems we've been spotted.
Your Highness, I expect the enemy's resistance to intensify.
Please exercise extreme caution in your command.
m920153.……闇ギルドの頃から、良いウワサは聞かなかったよ。\nただ、誰もその素顔を見たこ:
……There was never a good word said about him,
not even back when we were in the Dark Guild.
It's just that no one has ever seen his face.
m920153.……雰囲気を出すためだ。雰囲気を。\n特に理由はないぞ。:
……It's for the atmosphere. The atmosphere.
There's no particular reason.
m920153.あ、すみませんカミラ。\nありがとうございます。:
Ah, I'm sorry, Camilla.
Thank you.
m920153.ああ、もちろんだ。もう、もう嫌なんだ……。\nフォーさんにはついていけない……。:
Ah, of course. I'm done with this……
I can't keep following Four……
But if I betray him, what punishment is waiting for me……
m920153.ああ、サンタヘイオス。\nどうやら剣を抜くしかないらしい。:
Aye, Santa Heios.
It seems we have no choice but to draw our swords.
m920153.ああ、楽しみだ……。\n次はどんな遊びを――ギギッ、シテ、ヤロウ、カ――:
Ah, I can't wait…….
What kind of game shall I play next—creak, what a shame, I'm done for—
m920153.ああ、話せば長くなるんだが――: Ah, it's a long story, but――
m920153.ああ。サンタクロースの一族より、\n今年のクリスマスへの助力を請われし\n光と闇:
Indeed. We are the knights of light and darkness,
summoned by the Santa Claus clan
to aid this year's Christmas.
m920153.ああ。ヘイオスなら――いや、\nサンタヘイオスなら分かってくれると思っていた。:
Yes. I thought if it were Heios――
 no, if it were Santa Heios, you would understand.
m920153.ああ。街とクリスマスと、\n子どもたちの未来は守られたんだ。:
Indeed. The town, Christmas,
and the children's future have been protected.
m920153.あいつは生きるためでも稼ぐためでもなく、\nただ愉しいからって人を殺していた。\:
He didn't kill people for survival or for money.
He did it simply because it was fun.
…This is likely part of that, too.
m920153.あっ、そうなのね！\nふふっ、それなら吹雪が収まるまで、\nおとなしくぬくぬくし:
Oh, really!
Hehe, well then, let's stay cozy and warm
until the blizzard clears♪
m920153.あっ、でもまだ屋外で遊んでいる方がいますよ。\n――おーい！ 吹雪が強くなります:
Ah, but there are still some people playing outside.
――Hey, everyone! The blizzard is getting stronger,
so please come back inside!
m920153.あっ、よわよわ王子！\n危険だから来ちゃだめだよ！\nサンタが襲撃してくるの知ら:
Oh, Wobbly Prince!
It's dangerous, so don't come near!
Don't you know Santa Claus is going to attack?
m920153.あったりまえだろ？\n王子と言ったら\nこの辺の山賊の頭みてぇなモンなんだからな:
Well, that's only natural, isn't it?
The Prince is basically the boss of the local bandits
around here, after all.
m920153.あのプレゼントボックスが爆弾だとすると……。\nこれはまずいね、被害は倍じゃ済ま:
If those present boxes are bombs…….
This is bad. The damage could be way more than double!
m920153.あらあら、全然無事じゃないわよ？\n遅れちゃったおもちゃの製造も急がないとだし、:
Oh my, it's hardly saved, is it?
We're already behind on the toy manufacturing,
and we still have to deliver all the presents!
m920153.あれぇ……全然聞こえてないですね……。\nみなさーん！ 早く戻ってきてくださーい:
Hm……I can't hear them at all……
Everyone! Please come back inside right away!!
m920153.あれ？ えっと、クリスマスは、\nサンタクロースが襲撃してくるから危険なんだよね:
Huh? Wait, Christmas is…
it's dangerous because Santa Claus attacks, right?
m920153.いいねぇ、強気なのは好みだ。\n――でも、俺の計画を邪魔した罰は受けてもらおうか:
Good. I like it when you're defiant.
—But you'll have to pay for meddling with my plans.
m920153.いいや、違う。\nヘイオス、これはとても重要なことだ。\n今の私のことは、サンタ:
No, I'm not.
 Heios, this is very important.
 Please call me Santa Cornelia.
m920153.いえ、ちょっと相談に乗っただけですよ。\n可愛い女の子が悩んでいたら助ける。\n:
Oh, I was just listening to her worries.
When a cute girl is troubled, you help her.
It's the natural duty of a knight, isn't it?
m920153.いえ、誰かがいたような気配がしたのですが……。\n私の気のせいだったようですね。:
No, I could have sworn I sensed someone there…
It must have been my imagination.
m920153.いえいえ、予期せぬ雪中訓練もできましたし、\n結果としては良かったのではないかと:
Oh, don't mention it. We did get some unexpected snow training in,
so I suppose it turned out for the best.
――Ah, I am Santa Heios, by the way!
m920153.いや、サンタとは過酷で孤独な使命なんだ。\nもし配達中にプレゼントが奪われでもし:
No, being Santa is a harsh and lonely mission.
 If our gifts were stolen during delivery,
 we would make children all over the world cry, wouldn't we?
m920153.うわぁ、見えてる罠ばかりだよこれ。\nどう見ても素人のお仕事だねぇ。:
Whoa, I can see all the traps.
This really looks like amateur work.
m920153.えぇ、ボクも先日、あの話を聞くまでは、\n本当に楽しいお祭りだと思っていたんです: Yes, I thought so too, right up until I heard that story the other day!
m920153.えぇ、戦場ではそういう者を\n数多く見てきましたから。:
Yes. I've seen plenty of people like that
on the battlefield.
m920153.えぇ。それではここは任せました。\nクリスマス破壊――いえ、\nクリスマス爆破作:
I do. Then I'll leave this to you.
I wonder how the Christmas Destruction— I mean,
the Christmas Bombing Operation will turn out...
m920153.えぇっ！ うんっ、もちろんいいよー！\n何食べにいこうか？\nせっかくだからすっ:
Really! Yes, of course!
What should we eat?
Since it's a special occasion, let's get something amazing!
m920153.えぇっ！？ そ、それはだめです！\n計画が――あっ、えっと、なんでも無いです！:
What!? N-No, that's no good!
The plan is— Ah, I mean, I didn't say anything!
m920153.おぉ……あの白と黒の髪色は、\nまさか王国軍のヘイオス殿では！:
Oh…… that white and black hair……
Could it be Lord Heios of the Kingdom's army?!
m920153.おお、サンタクロースの一族の協力者か！\nサンタの騎士たちよ、敵はすでに\nおも:
Oh, allies of the Santa Claus clan!
Knights of Santa, the enemies are already heading for the toy factory.
Be careful!
m920153.おやおやぁ？ 何を手こずっているんだい？\n君たちには侵入者の\n抹殺を命じたは:
My, my? What's taking you so long?
I ordered you to exterminate the intruders, didn't I?
m920153.くっ……王子、フォーが工場の奥に逃げるぞ！: Grr… Prince, Fo is fleeing toward the back of the factory!
m920153.くっ、待てファイブ！！\n……ちっ、船で逃げやがった。:
Curses, wait, Five!!
…Tch. They fled by ship.
m920153.けーかく？\nうーん、でもエフネちゃんが\nそこまで言うなら、本当に危険なのかも:
Plan?
Hmm, well, if Eithne is saying it's that serious,
maybe it really is dangerous…
m920153.この吹雪は魔力の乱れによるものですから、\nもう少しすれば収まると思いますよ？:
This blizzard is caused by a disturbance in the magical currents,
so I think it should die down soon.
m920153.この連中が噂に聞く闇の組織なのか……？\n街を包囲されていちゃ救援要請もできない:
Could these be the Dark Organization we've been hearing about……?
With the town surrounded, we can't even send out a distress call.
If only we could get a messenger to the Kingdom……!
m920153.さぁ一緒に、クリスマスパーティへ出かけましょう♪: So let's go together to the Christmas party♪
m920153.さすがは騎士さま、気配にも敏感か。\n王子、この辺りは任せたよ。\nあっちの森は:
You really are something, Sir Knight.
You're sensitive to even the faintest scents.
Prince, this area is yours.
We'll handle the forest over there.
m920153.さて、それは尋問してのお楽しみかな。\n王子、アサシンの攻撃には気をつけろ！\n:
Well, we'll find out during interrogation.
Prince, watch out for the assassins!
They might use a poison that doubles the pain!
m920153.さて、そろそろお静かに。\nもう拠点が見えてくるはずですよ。:
Now then, let's keep our voices down.
We should be able to see the base soon.
m920153.さて！ クリスマス本番まであと少し！\n王子殿下、もう一度訓練のお相手をお願いし:
Now then! The real Christmas is just around the corner!
Your Highness, please be my sparring partner one more time!
m920153.さァ！ 遊んでやろうじゃないか！！\nハーッハァ！！:
Come now! Let's have some fun!!
Hah hah!!
m920153.そ、そうです！ そうなんです！\nざこざこ王子のためにも、\n急いでこの隠れ家を:
Y-Yes! Exactly!
For the sake of the Tiny Prince,
we should fortify this hideout right away!
m920153.そういうわけなので王子殿下、\nこれよりサンタ戦力向上のため、私の――\nサンタ:
That's why, Your Highness,
 in order to strengthen our Santa forces, I――
 Santa Heios, need you to accompany me in training!
m920153.そうですね……。\n王子殿下、おもちゃ工場へ急ぎましょう！:
I suppose so…
Your Highness, we must hurry to the toy factory!
m920153.そうなの……！？\nあっ、でもきっとよわよわ王子が守ってくれるよ？\nよわよわ王:
Is that really true!?
Ah, but the Wobbly Prince will surely protect us, right?
The Wobbly Prince is actually a Super Strong Prince, you see♪
m920153.そしてこれからも、ですね！\n王子、こんな楽しい日々を守るために、\nこれからも:
And they will remain that way from now on!
Prince, let's keep working hard
to protect these joyful days♪
m920153.その意気です！\n――とはいえ、その前に肩慣らしが必要そうですが。:
That's the spirit!
――That said, we'll need to warm up first.
m920153.それから、サンタからの贈り物は、\n無事にすべての子どもたちの分が揃ったようです:
Also, it seems Santa's gifts
have been successfully prepared for all the children.
Hehe, I hope it turns out to be a wonderful Christmas.
m920153.それではこちらは私が。\n王子さま、指揮をお願いしますね！: Then I'll take this side. Prince, please lead the command!
m920153.それでは王子、私たちも王国へ戻りましょうか。\n此度の闇の組織征伐、お疲れさまで:
Then, Prince, shall we return to the kingdom?
Well done on subduing the dark organization!
m920153.それでは行きますよ、王子殿下！\nメリー……クリスマース！！:
Then let's begin, Your Highness!
Merry…… Christmas!!
m920153.それよりこの爆薬の量よ。\nこれだけ詰め込んでいるんだから、\nおもちゃ工場なん:
But look at the amount of explosives here.
With that much packed in,
the toy factory must be in for a real blast…
m920153.それより！\nクリスマスパーティの準備が整いましたよ！\n国民の皆さんも、王子の:
But more importantly!
The preparations for the Christmas party are complete!
The citizens are eagerly awaiting the Prince's speech!
m920153.そんなやつが、\nどうしておもちゃを狙うのでしょうか……。\nますます分からなく:
A man like that……
Why would he be targeting the toys?
Things are getting even more confusing.
m920153.だから！ さぁ！\n存分に苦しみ、傷つき、死にそうになりながら！\n――その強さ:
So! Come now!
Suffer to your heart's content, be wounded, and teeter on the brink of death!
—Show me that strength. Hahaha!!
m920153.だが、こちらも次の仕事があるんでね。\n先にお暇させてもらうとしよう。:
But we've got our next job to attend to.
I'll take my leave before things get complicated.
m920153.だが楽しみが増えた！！\n強い人間が絶望に濡れた時、\nそれでも立ち上がるのかど:
But this just makes it more fun!!
When a strong human is drenched in despair,
will they still manage to rise again??
m920153.ちっ、見つかったか！\n王子気をつけろ、敵の抵抗が激しくなるぞ！:
Tch, we've been spotted!
Prince, be careful. The enemy's resistance is going to intensify!
m920153.で、でも、闇の組織の狙いはお金ですよね？\nプレゼントを爆破するって、いったい何:
But the Dark Organization's goal is money, right?
What's the point of blowing up the presents…?
m920153.でもおかげで壊しやすいってものさ。\n王子、先に罠を壊してから、\n兵を展開した:
But that means they're easy to break.
Prince, it'd be best to clear out the traps first
before deploying the troops.
m920153.でも油断は禁物ですよ。\n吹雪も強くなってきましたし、\n襲撃犯からすれば絶好の:
But we can't let our guard down.
The blizzard is picking up, too.
It's the perfect opportunity for an attacker.
m920153.でも足止めさえしてしまえばこちらのもの。\n隠れられないようにしてやりましょう！:
But if we can pin them down, it's our turn.
Let's make sure they can't stay hidden!
m920153.ところが、何とクリスマスの日には、\nサンタクロースという怖ろしい怪物が、\n家:
It turns out that on Christmas Day,
a terrifying monster called Santa Claus
breaks into people's homes…!
m920153.ともかく、今は情報を集めましょう。\n――おい、向こうで火と食事を用意してやる。:
In any case, let's gather information.
――Hey, we'll get you a fire and some food over there.
I'll keep you safe.
m920153.どうやら、後を追うには\nこれを片付けるしかないようですね。\n王子殿下、迎撃の:
It seems we have no choice but to deal with these
if we're to give him pursuit.
Prince, please take command of the interception!
m920153.なっ……じ、自爆した……？\n王子、フォーが自爆しました！:
Wha… he, he blew himself up…?
Prince, Fo self-destructed!
m920153.なるほど……？\nともかく、大きな騒動にならなくてよかったです。\n王子、私たち:
I see……?
Anyway, I'm glad things didn't turn into a bigger commotion.
Prince, shall we head back to base?
m920153.なんだ、存外早い到着じゃないか……。\nもっと悲鳴を聞かせてくれると思ったんだけ:
Well, well, you arrived sooner than I expected…
I was hoping to hear a few more screams.
m920153.は、はぁ……。\nそれでサンタコーネリアは、\n何の用事で私を呼び出したのでしょ:
H-huh...
 So, Santa Cornelia,
 what is the reason for summoning me?
m920153.は、はいっ！ アイリーン姐さん！\n全部、全部お話いたします！: Y-yes! Irene-senpai! I'll tell you everything!
m920153.はぁ……はぁ……。\nありがとうございました、殿下。\nおかげでサンタとして、強:
Haa…… haa…….
Thank you, Your Highness.
I feel like I've grown stronger as a Santa!
m920153.はい王子殿下、今年最初の\n「サンタからの贈り物」です♪\nプレゼントを渡す練習:
Here, Your Highness. This is the first
"gift from Santa" of the year♪
We need to practice handing out presents too!
m920153.ははっ、王国軍の皆さんが護衛について、\n犯人も怖気づいたのかもしれませんよ。:
Haha, with the Royal Army providing an escort,
the culprit may have been scared off.
m920153.ふぅ、隠れてた連中もこれで全部だな。\nおい、どうして馬車を襲撃したんだ？:
Phew, that should be all the ones hiding.
Hey, why did you attack the carriage?
m920153.ふふ、そういうことですか。\n……エフネちゃん、ちょっとこちらへ。:
Fufu, I see.
…Eithne, come here for a moment.
m920153.ふふ、そういう意味じゃ、\n闇ギルドの後継組織は王国の方かもしれないな。:
Fufu, in that sense,
the Dark Guild's true successor might be the kingdom itself.
m920153.ふふ、今年はホワイトクリスマスになったわね。\nもう子どもたちが外に遊びに出てき:
Hehe, it's a white Christmas this year.
The children are already out playing again.
m920153.ふふっ、ええ。\n未来を担う子どもたちのために！:
Hehe, yes.
For the children who will carry the future!
m920153.ふふっ、まさか。\n幹部同士は友好的でいたいだけですよ。\n内紛で滅びては元も子:
Fufu, not at all.
I just want us executives to remain on good terms.
If we destroy ourselves through infighting,
we'll have nothing left.
m920153.ふふっ、照れるコーネリア――いえ、\nサンタコーネリアも可愛いですね。:
Heh, shy Cornelia――no,
Santa Cornelia is adorable too.
m920153.ふふっ、風向きの読みが甘いな。\nこちらも行くぞ、雪玉砲弾――放てッ！！:
Hehe, your reading of the wind direction is a bit off.
Here comes my snowball shell――fire!!
m920153.へへっ、そうだな。\nガキの楽しみくらい守ってやらないと。:
Heh, you're right.
We've got to protect the kids' fun.
m920153.またおもちゃ工場、ですか……。\n王子、急いで雪の国へ向かいましょう。\nフォー:
The toy factory again…
Prince, we must head to the Snow Country immediately.
To stop Four's crimes!
m920153.まるで模擬戦でもするかのような大所帯じゃない。\nプレゼント配りに戦闘は必要ない:
This is quite a large group, as if we're about to have a sparring match.
 You don't need combat for gift delivery, do you?
m920153.も、ぎせ、ん……？\nあっ、模擬戦をするよって言ってるのかな……？:
Mo-gi-zen……?
Ah, could he be saying we're doing a mock battle……?
m920153.も、もういいんですっ！\nボクの嘘、ですから……。:
N-No, forget it!
It was my lie, after all…
m920153.もう、あちこち怪我してるじゃないですか。\n癒やしの魔法をかけてあげますから、\:
Oh, look at all those injuries.
Let me cast a healing spell on you.
Please come over here right away.
m920153.もはや、一刻の猶予もありませんね。\nクリスマスと子どもたちを守るため、\n急い:
We have no time to spare.
To protect Christmas and the children,
we must hurry to the back of the factory!
m920153.や、闇の組織ですか……！？\nどうして闇の組織がプレゼントを……。:
T-The Dark Organization?!
Why would the Dark Organization steal the presents……?
m920153.よぉし、打倒サンタクロース！\nクリスマスを生き残るよー！:
Alright, let's defeat Santa Claus!
We're going to survive Christmas!
m920153.よし、ここの製造ラインは止まりました！: Good. This production line is stopped!
m920153.わ、わかりました。\nボク、頑張ってみます！:
I-I understand.
I'll give it my best shot!
m920153.ん……このやり口、見覚えがあるな。\n闇ギルド――うぅん、闇の組織の\nアサシン:
Hm…… I recognize this tactic.
The Dark Guild――no, the Dark Organization's
assassins set their traps this way.
m920153.ん……サンタヘイオスが何か叫んでいるな。\nなになに……「も」……？:
Hm……Santa Heios is shouting something.
What is it……"mo"……?
m920153.アイリーン姐さん、でまかせかもしれないよ。\nフォーの手下だって言うならなおさら:
Sister Irene, this might be a lie.
Especially coming from one of Four's underlings.
m920153.エフネさんが何を企んでいるのか分かりませんが、\nこんな危険な場所におふたりを\:
I have no idea what Eithne is up to,
but I can't leave you two
in such a dangerous place.
m920153.セブン、深追いはいけません。\n――周囲をよく見てください。:
Seven, do not pursue him too deep.
—Look around you carefully.
m920153.テティスさん？\nえっ、内緒ばなしですか？:
Thetis?
Huh, is this a secret talk?
m920153.ハァ……なんだ、魔王を倒したってのは本当だったか。\nこんなに強いなら\nもう少:
Haa……so it was true. You actually defeated a Demon Lord.
If you're this strong,
I should have prepared some better toys.
m920153.ハハハッ！ 生産ラインを止める鍵は、\nこの俺の腹の中にあるぞ？:
Hahaha! The key to stopping the production line
is right here, inside my gut!
m920153.ハハハ！ まぁいいさ！\n戦う気のある人間の最期っていうのも久々だ。\n無力に嘆:
Hahaha! Well, never mind!
It's been a while since I saw the last stand of a human willing to fight.
Struggling helplessly is less impressive than putting up a fight, after all.
m920153.ハハハ！ まぁいいさ！\n最後にはどっちかが死ぬんだ。\n俺も手伝ってやるから、:
Hahaha! Well, it doesn't matter!
In the end, one of them is going to die.
I'll help out, so go kill them!
m920153.ハーッハッハッハッハァ！！\n俺を倒した！ 俺の人形を殺したぞこいつらァ！！: Hahaha!! You took me down! You killed my dolls, you lot!!
m920153.フォー、あなたの企みもここまでです。\nクリスマスを破壊することは、\n私たちが:
Fo, your schemes end here.
We will never allow you to destroy Christmas.
m920153.フォー人形をけしかけるつもりなのだろう。\n製造中は無害だろうが、\n完成すれば:
He's trying to set the Fo dolls on us.
They're harmless while they're being made,
but once they're finished, they'll come straight for us.
m920153.フッ……そうだな。\nサンタヘイオス、共に子どもたちの夢を紡ぎに行くぞ。:
Heh……you're right.
Santa Heios, let's go weave the children's dreams together.
m920153.ヘイオス、今の私はコーネリアではない。: Heios, I am not Cornelia right now.
m920153.下手に怖気づかれても困るんですけどね……。\nあっ、でも危険な目にはあわせません:
I'd rather they weren't scared off, though……
Ah, but I won't let you get hurt!
We will protect this carriage, no matter what!
m920153.久々に愉快な連中が現れたもんだァ……。\n愉快に派手に殺してやるよ！\n――そら:
It's been ages since I met such entertaining opponents…
I'll put on a real show while I kill you!
—There! BOOOOOM!!
