Huh…… Huh?
So you're going to be my sponsor and producer, Prince?
m920191.えっ、えぇー！？\n最初は王国じゃないの！？:
Wha—what?!
It's not in the kingdom at all?!
m920191.えっ、えっ、勝負？\nでもアイドルって戦ったりするわけじゃ……。:
Wh-What? A match?
But idols don't really fight or anything……
m920191.えっ、お、王子！？ どこいくの！？\n――あ、アンナさんを助けにいくって！？:
Huh? P-Prince?! Where are you going?!
――Ah, you're going to help Anna, aren't you?!
--- scene: The Legendary Idol (battle, end) ---
m920191.えっ、アイドルって、歌って踊る子のことよね？\nそんな特殊な存在なの？:
Huh? An idol is someone who sings and dances, right?
Is that such a special existence?
m920191.えっ？ ま、魔物！？\n大変だ……ミヤビ、近くの砦に報告をお願い！:
Huh? M-monsters?!
This is bad…… Miyabi, please report to the nearest fortress!
m920191.えへへ、ライブ大成功だね！！: Hehe, the live show was a huge success!!
m920191.おぉ……なるホド……！！\nメカゴブリンクイーン様を想ってのその決意、\nグスッ:
Oh… I see…!!
That resolve, born of your love for Queen Mechagoblin…
Sniff… I accept it…!!
m920191.おだまり三女！\nこれは打算じゃないのよ！:
Shut up, Third Daughter!
This isn't about calculation!
m920191.おや、リノ様。\nこの度はフェスの参加にご快諾いただき――:
Oh, Lady Rino.
Thank you for graciously agreeing to participate in the festival—
m920191.おやおや、この王国に、\n誰かの夢を笑うような人はいないと思いますよ？:
Oh my. I don't think there's anyone in this kingdom
who would laugh at someone's dreams.
m920191.くぅぅ、しかし、もっと聴きたい……。\nいったいどうすれば……。:
Ugh……but I want to hear more……
What should I do……
m920191.くっ……なんだ、この気持ちは……。\n戦の興奮とも違う、む、胸が、ドキドキして…:
Grrr…… what is this feeling…….
It's different from the thrill of battle. My, my chest is…… pounding…….
m920191.けっ、リノ嬢の武力は大したものだが、\n軟弱なウタなんかで、俺達の心は震えないぜ:
Tch. Miss Rino may have impressive combat skills,
but there's no way a flimsy little song like that could move our hearts.
m920191.このステージだけでは、まだまだ足りないと？: So this stage alone isn't enough?
m920191.この村のオークたちが、音楽などにうつつを抜かし、\n戦士の誇りを汚したことは我が:
I'll report back to my village that its Orcs were distracted by music and sullied the pride of warriors!
Remember this, you… delicate… songstress!!
m920191.これ……あ、アイドルの衣装！？\nサラマンダー、違うよ、今必要なのは戦う力で――:
This is…… ah, an idol outfit!?
Salamander, no, what I need right now is the power to fight, and——
m920191.これが、アイドルの輝きか……。\n見よ、あのふたりが、誰よりも輝いている……！！:
So this is the radiance of an idol...
Look, those two are shining brighter than anyone...!!
m920191.これが！ 文化……ッ！！: This is it! This is culture……!
m920191.これだから人間と交流を持つような連中は……。\n軟弱な音楽など、この村ごと破壊し:
This is what happens when you start mixing with humans…….
I'll destroy this village along with its flimsy music!
m920191.さぁ、リノさんのアイドルロード、\nこの執務室から始まりますよー！:
Well then, Rino-san's road to stardom
begins right here in this office!
m920191.さぁ、本番まであと少し！\n王子プロデューサー、\n最後まで油断せずに駆け抜けま:
Now then, just a little more until the main event!
Prince Producer,
let's run this race to the finish without letting our guard down!!
m920191.さぁ、次はあたしたちのライバル！\nリノちゃんのステージ！！:
Now then, next up is our rivals!
Rino's stage!!
m920191.さぁ王子、そろそろ王国軍の出番ですよ。: Well then, Prince, it's about time for the Royal Army to make its move.
m920191.さぁ王子、ゴブリンのオンナに酔いしれなさァい！！\n――アイドルは、色香！！:
Now then, Prince, let yourself be intoxicated
by the beauty of Goblin women!!
――An idol is all about allure!!
m920191.さて、分からぬぞ。\n伝説のアイドルは、その歌で心だけでなく、\n魔力まで震わせ:
Well, I can't say for sure.
I've heard that the legendary idol's songs shook not just hearts,
but even magic power, summoning monsters to her side…….
m920191.ざこざこな応援、輝いてましたよー！！: Your enthusiastic cheering was absolutely dazzling!!
m920191.ざこざこのくせに最前線に出るから……。\nそんなにボクにイイトコ見せたかったんで:
For a bunch of underlings to rush to the front line…
Did you really want to show me off so badly?
m920191.しょうたいじょう……？\n誰からだろ……ん、インテリデーモンさん？:
An invitation……?
Who's it from……Hm, an Intel Demon?
m920191.じゃあ、もう一曲行っちゃいますか？\nねっ、聴きたいですよねー？:
Then, how about one more song?
Right? You all want to hear it, don't you?
m920191.じゃあ、皆で歌っちゃおうか！\nリノと、エス★エフと、会場のみんなで！:
Then let's sing together!
Rino, Es★Fu, and everyone in the audience!
m920191.すてっぷすてっぷ、クルッと回って、\nはーとまーくでにこっ♪ ――ふぁぁぁ、でき:
Step, step, spin around,
heart mark, smile~♪ —Phew, got it!
m920191.すぽんさーと、ぷろでゅーさー……。\nうぅぅ、そんなの頼める人いないよぉ。:
A spon-sor, and a pro-du-er……
Ugh, I don't know anyone I could ask for that.
m920191.そ、そうですね！\nこの目に焼き付けなければ！！:
Y-Yes, that's right!
I have to burn this image into my memory!!
m920191.そ、そうなの？\nそういえば、アンナさんのライブでも、\n会場警備をしてる人がい:
R-Really?
Now that you mention it, there were people handling security at Anna's live shows too……
m920191.そう、アイドルは――輝き。\nこうしてはいられないわ！\n次のフェスに向けて、今:
Yes, an idol is—radiance.
We can't just stand here!
Starting special training for the next festival, right now!!
m920191.そういう時は、なんて言うんだっけー！？: What do we say in a situation like this?!
m920191.そういう時は、アンコールするんですよ。\nさぁ皆さんご一緒に♪:
In that case, you ask for an encore.
Come on, everyone, sing along♪
m920191.そう！ なので王子、ステージに\n上がってきちゃう子たちを、\nどこどこ倒して観:
Exactly! So, Prince, we'll take down the ones who jump up onto the stage
and gently escort them back to their seats!
m920191.それじゃあ、もしかしてふたりも……！: So, does that mean you two are……!
m920191.それじゃあ、次が最後の曲です。\nライブが終わっちゃうの寂しいけど、\nでも、み:
Well then, this is our final song.
I'll be sad when the live show ends,
but I'll always be with you all!
m920191.それじゃあゲネプロ始めます！\n会場の観客誘導、照明音響もこれが最後のあわせです:
Then, let's begin the general rehearsal!
This is the final run-through for audience flow, lighting, and sound!
Let's give it our all to make this the best stage ever!
m920191.それじゃあリノさん、会場で会いましょうね！: Well then, Rino-san, see you at the venue!
m920191.それに、こんな夢のこと話せるの、\nあの時あの場所にいたミヤビくらいで……。:
Besides, you're the only one I could talk to
about a dream like this, back then……
m920191.ただ、アイドルはアイドル本人だけではライブができません。\n会場そのものを用意し:
However, an idol can't put on a live performance on her own.
You need people to prepare the venue, arrange security,
and manage the audience's entry and exit.
m920191.ただそこにあるだけで、輝かずにはいられない。\n魂そのものが視線を引き付ける存在:
Simply existing there, yet unable to help but shine.
A being whose very soul draws the gaze.
That is… that is an idol…
m920191.たのしむ……歌を、ステージを……。\n…………。\n…………うん、行けそう。:
Have fun… with the song, with the stage…
……
……Yeah, I think I can do this.
m920191.だから……リノもみんなに、この歌を届けたい。\nみんな、聴いてくれる！？:
So… Rino wants to share this song with everyone.
Everyone, will you listen?!
m920191.つまり、スポンサーが必要なんです！\nそして多くの人に届けるには、\n企画を打ち:
In other words, you need a sponsor!
And to reach a wide audience,
you also need a producer to promote the project!
m920191.でも、アイドルのライブを見た後に、\nファンになるどころか、\n自分もアイドルに:
But to watch an idol's live show and,
instead of just becoming a fan,
decide you want to be an idol yourself.
m920191.でも、フェス本番前に良いリハーサルができました。\nリノさんに足りないのは場数だ:
But we got a good rehearsal in before the big show.
All Rino needs is stage experience, so
getting to interact with a rival was a real bonus.
m920191.でも、リノが頑張らなくちゃ。\n村のみんなを、リノが守るんだ……！:
But I have to keep going.
I'll protect everyone in the village……!
m920191.どうやら、ファンになっちゃったみたいですね！: It seems you've become a fan!
m920191.どうやら、歌に感動しすぎて、\n戦闘に集中できなくなっているようですね。\n兵た:
It seems he's so moved by the song
that he can't focus on the battle.
Sound the order! Now is the time to knock their weapons away!
m920191.どう？ もう一曲聴きたくなった？: Well? Do you want to hear another song?
m920191.どきどき……。\n王国の村とかかな……。:
My heart is pounding……
Is it in one of the kingdom's villages or something……?
m920191.な、なんだってんダヨ！\n確かにメチャクチャカワイイし、\n胸がドキドキするけど:
W-What do you mean?!
Sure, she's super cute,
and my heart's pounding, but she's just an unknown rookie, right?!
m920191.なっ……妨害装置が粉々に……！？\nなんということを……！！:
Wha… The sabotage device is in pieces…!?
What is this…!!
m920191.なになに……。\nアイドルフェスのおしらせ？:
Let's see…….
An announcement for an idol festival?
m920191.なにィ……？\n良かろう、歌ごときで戦士を鼓舞できるのかどうか、\nその身をもっ:
What was that……?
Very well. Show me with your own body whether a song can rouse a warrior,
you little girl!!
m920191.なるほど、それはたしかに……？\n人前に立つ事の多かったアンナさ――アンナちゃん:
I see, that is certainly…?
It also explains why Anna—Anna-chan, who was often in front of people,
was able to become a top idol.
m920191.なんだァ？ エス★エフに気圧されて、\n全然喋れてネェじゃねーか。\nフェスに新:
What's with that? You're so intimidated by E★F
you can't even get a word out.
Bringing a rookie to a festival like this is just cruel!
m920191.はぁ……これで終わっちゃうなんて、\nなんだか寂しいな……。:
Haa… It feels a little lonely
knowing it's over…
m920191.はぁ……はぁ……♪\nうぅぅ、物足りない、まだ足りないよー！:
Haa... haa... ♪
Uuu, I want more, I'm still not satisfied!
m920191.はぁ……アンナさん、すっごい輝いてる……。\nうぅぅ、ライブ来てよかったなぁ……:
Ah…… Anna is shining so brightly……
Ugh, I'm so glad I came to the live show……
m920191.はぁ、はぁ……。\nきりがないなぁ……！ オーガまで出てきたし……。:
Haa, haa……
They just keep coming……! Even an ogre showed up……
m920191.はいっ！\nそれじゃ王子、元の場所に戻ろっか。:
Yes!
Come on, Prince, let's head back to our seats.
m920191.はっ……しかし、あの名高いリノ嬢が、\n今はアイドルなどという軟弱なものに――:
Yes……but the renowned Miss Rino is now
engaged in something as frivolous as being an idol――
m920191.はっ……リノ嬢と目があって……くぅぅぅ！\nくそっ、戦士の誇り！ 我が修行の日々:
Hah… I made eye contact with Miss Rino… ugh!
Damn it, my pride as a warrior! Remember my days of training!
m920191.はっ、かの王子を始め、\nサラマンダーを従える召喚士、リノ嬢の姿も……。:
Yes. The Prince himself,
and the summoner, Miss Rino, with her Salamander in tow……
m920191.はて、何のことかさっぱり……。: I'm afraid I have no idea what you're talking about...
m920191.ふぁ、ん……？\nそうか、リノ嬢のファンになったのか、俺は……！:
F-Fan……?
So that's it, I've become a fan of Miss Rino……!
m920191.ふざけるな！\n軟弱な音楽を聴きたいなどと……くっ、この俺が……！:
Don't be ridiculous!
To think I'd want to listen to flimsy music…… grrr, me……!
m920191.ふふ、オークには戦歌の文化もある。\nそれに会場費用は王国軍との模擬戦払いでいい:
Heh, orcs have a culture of war songs too.
Plus, I hear the venue fee will be covered by the mock battle with the royal army.
Couldn't ask for better conditions for a debut show, could we?
m920191.ふふっ、良かったです。\nライブが中断になってしまったのは残念ですけど、\n喜ん:
Hehe, I'm glad.
It's a shame the show had to be interrupted,
but if you enjoyed it, my singing was worth it♪
m920191.ふふん、ボクらにも負けてない、最高のステージでした。\nやはりライバルとはこうで:
Heh, we didn't lose to you at all. That was the perfect stage.
This is what a true rivalry looks like.
m920191.ふむ……そういうことならお手伝いしましょう！\nダンスと、興行については色々教え:
Hmm…… Well, if that's the case, I'd be happy to help!
I can teach you all about dancing and show business.
m920191.へへっ、リノちゃんの歌を聞いてたら、\nなぜか力が湧いてきたんだ！:
Heh, listening to Rino-chan's song,
I suddenly felt a surge of strength!
m920191.ほほう、こちらから出向く手間が省けたわ。\nして、あちらの兵に名高き者はおるのか:
Hmph. That saves us the trouble of going to them.
Now then, is there anyone of note among those soldiers?
m920191.ほんの一言で、スイッチが入りました。\n今のリノさんは、完全にアイドルの顔をして:
With just one word, her switch flipped.
Rino just now looked exactly like an idol.
m920191.ま、魔物だー！！\nライブ会場に魔物が迫っているぞー！！:
M-Monsters!
Monsters are closing in on the live venue!
m920191.ま、魔物！？\nそんな、せっかくのアンナさんのライブが……。:
M-Monsters?!
No way…… right in the middle of Anna's live show……
m920191.まさか、色香が足りなかったというの……？: Could it be… that we lacked the charm?
m920191.みなさーん！ 今日はアンナの\n限定ライブに来てくれて、ありがとうーっ！！:
Everyone! Thank you so much for coming to
Anna's exclusive live show today!!
m920191.みんな、これがリノのデビューライブだよ！\n千年先まで届く輝きを！ みんなに！！:
Everyone, this is Rino's debut live show!
Let's shine in a way that will reach a thousand years into the future! For everyone!!
--- scene: First Live Show! (battle, end) ---
m920191.みんな、これがリノの歌だよ！\n――千年先まで、一緒に輝こう！！:
Everyone, this is Rino's song!
—Let's shine together, for a thousand years to come!!
m920191.みんな、アンコールありがとー！\n最後にもう一曲行くよ！\n千年先まで、リノと一:
Thanks for the encore, everyone!
One more song before we wrap up!
Follow Rino all the way to the future!
m920191.みんな、怪我はない！？\nあぁもう、擦り傷もケガに違いないでしょ！\nほら、消毒:
Everyone, are you hurt?
Oh, come on, even a scratch counts as an injury!
Here, let me disinfect it!
m920191.みんな、来てくれたんだ！\n客席のみんなー！ 声出してー！\n飛び跳ねてー！ リ:
Everyone came!
Audience, let's hear you!
Jump around! Follow Rino!!
m920191.みんなの声、聴かせてー！！\nリノと一緒に歌おー！！:
Let me hear everyone's voices!
Sing along with Rino!
--- scene: On Stage! (battle, end) ---
m920191.みんな！ リノと一緒に、\n千年先まで輝く伝説になろ！:
Everyone! Let's make a legend
that shines for a thousand years, together with Rino!
m920191.よぉし、じゃあもう一曲歌っちゃうね！\nミヤビ、ミヤビも一緒に……って、あれ？\:
Alright, then I'll sing one more song!
Miyabi, let's do it together…… wait, where did she go?
Where'd you go!? Miyabi! Hey!!
m920191.よく知ってる人だけに、歌を届けたいんですか？: Do you only want to deliver your song to people you know well?
m920191.わっ……次が最後の曲だって！\nすごい、皆の期待と声援で、\nまるで会場全体が揺:
Wha…… it's the final song!
Wow, the crowd's cheers and excitement
are making the whole venue shake!
m920191.アイドルが不安になってちゃいけませんよ。\n歌は、人の心を震わせられるんです。\:
An idol must not be anxious.
A song has the power to stir people's hearts.
If you sing while feeling anxious, you'll only spread that anxiety to everyone.
m920191.アイドルとか、リノはまだ良くわからないけど……。\nでも、歌はきっと、誰にだって:
I still don't really understand what being an idol means...
But I know that songs can reach anyone.
No matter how far, songs can reach.
m920191.アイドルにとって、大舞台でのライブは\nあくまでスタートラインなんですよ？:
For an idol, a live performance on a big stage
is just the starting line, you know?
m920191.アイドルは……ゴブリンプリンセス！！: An idol is… the Goblin Princesses!!
m920191.アイドルは……君臨するものではないのですね。: An idol is… not one who reigns, I see.
m920191.アイドルは、火力！！: An idol is all about firepower!!
m920191.アイドルは、誰より貪欲なんですよ。: Idols are the most greedy of all.
m920191.アイドルは金、アイドルは人脈、\nアイドルとは――稼ぎこそすべて！！:
Idols are money, idols are connections,
and idols are—nothing but profit!!
m920191.アイドル文化は芽生え始めたばかりですから。\n今はお作法というものが浸透していな:
Idol culture is still in its infancy.
The proper etiquette hasn't really taken hold yet.
For instance, what happens when the singing gets heated up at a tavern?
m920191.アンナさん！ ライブ、とっても素敵だったよ！\nうぅぅ、私もうずうずしてきちゃっ:
Anna! The live show was amazing!
Ugh, I was so excited I could barely sit still!
m920191.ウフン、あるじゃない。\n王子に直接売り込みにいけばいいのよ……！！:
Mm-hmm, but we have one.
We just have to pitch ourselves directly to the Prince…!!
m920191.オークさんたちって、みんな武人ばかりでしょ？\nリノの歌、ちゃんと届く、かな……:
Aren't the Orcs all warriors?
I wonder if my song will really reach them…….
m920191.グワッハッハッハ！ おぉ、それは重畳！\n召喚士とはぜひとも戦ってみたかったのだ:
Gwahaha! Oh, that is splendid!
I have long wished to test my strength against a summoner!
m920191.ゲリラライブ、大成功でしたね！: The guerrilla live was a huge success!
m920191.ゴブリンさんたちもこっち来てー！\n早く手当てしないと跡が残っちゃうよ！:
Goblin ladies, come over here!
If we don't treat your wounds soon, they'll leave scars!
m920191.ゴブリン軍団！\nプリンセス親衛隊の舞を見セヨ！！:
Goblin Legion!
Show the Prince the dance of the Princesses' Guard!!
m920191.シカシ、フェスの出演は招待制……。\nワレワレには、ツテもコネも――:
However, festival appearances are by invitation only…
We have no connections or contacts――
m920191.ステージはこのとおり、しっかり守りきったぞ。: The stage was defended without a hitch, as you can see.
m920191.デモシェフ商会のですか？\nいったい何の招待なのでしょうか。:
From the Demoshop Trading Company?
What kind of invitation could it be?
m920191.ナッ……マサカ、あのリノ嬢をご存知ナイ！？: Wha… No way, you don't know who that Rino girl is?!
m920191.ハルモニアちゃん！ 泣いてる暇ないよ！\n次が最後！ 助手ちゃんたちの最後の歌だ:
Harmonia! No time for tears!
This is the last one! The assistants' final song!
m920191.フェスとは、アイドルとは、\n仕込みと根回しがすべて……。:
Festivals, idols...
It's all about groundwork and connections.
m920191.ホームでぬくぬくするより、\nアウェイにどんどん出ていかないと、\n世界中に届く:
You can't make music that reaches the whole world
if you just stay cozy in your home turf.
You have to venture out into unfamiliar territory!
m920191.リノ……ちゃん……。\nフンッ……せいぜい歌うがいい！\n今日だけは……あなたた:
Rino…-chan…
Hmph… Well, sing your heart out!
For today… you idols are the stars of the show!
m920191.リノさん、これは彼女たちからの挑戦状ですよ！: Rino-san, this is a challenge from them!
m920191.リノさん、そういうわけでボクらと勝負です！: Rino-san, so that's why we're challenging you to a match!
m920191.リノさん、巨躯のオークたちにも、\nあなたの歌は届いています！\nこのまま、ゲリ:
Miss Rino, your song is reaching
even the Giant-bodied Orcs!
Let's make this guerrilla live a success!
m920191.リノさん、筋が良いとは思っていましたけど、\nもうダンスの基礎を覚えてきましたね:
I did think you had the talent for it, Rino,
but you've really picked up the basics of dancing.
m920191.リノさん！ 炎の声を聞いて！\n今必要なのは、戦うだけの力ではないはずよ！:
Rino! Listen to the voice of the flames!
What you need now isn't just the power to fight!
m920191.リノちゃんの歌、楽しみにしてるね！: I'm looking forward to Rino-chan's song!
m920191.リノちゃーん！ 最高だったよー！\nうぅぅぅ、カワイイ！ かっわいいー！:
Rino-chaan! That was amazing!
Uuuu, so cute! So cuuuute!
m920191.リノはね、伝説のアイドル、アンナさんの歌を聴いて、\nいっぱい元気と勇気をもらっ:
I listened to the songs of the legendary idol, Anna,
and I got so much energy and courage from them.
m920191.リノは時間を稼ぐよ！\nリノだって、王国の召喚士なんだから！:
Rino will buy them some time!
I'm a summoner of the kingdom, after all!
m920191.一番イケてるオンナが、\n一番イケてるアイドルに\nならなくてどうするのという話:
The coolest woman
has to become the coolest idol,
or what's the point?
m920191.今日のライブは、神話にだってなるよ！\nだって、リノたちみんな、すごい輝いてるか:
Today's live performance will become a myth!
Because all of us, Rino and everyone, are shining so brightly!!
m920191.伝説のアイドル、アンナちゃんの安全の方が重要です！\nあなたは王国にいなくてはな:
The safety of the legendary idol Anna is the top priority!
You are an important figure who must remain in the kingdom!
m920191.何を失礼な、共演者のリノ様に、\n我が事務所から心ばかりの差し入れをと。:
How rude. I'm simply bringing a small gift from my agency
to our co-star, Lady Rino.
m920191.全然足りないですよ！\nリノさんは、もっともっと、\nたくさんの人に歌を届けたい:
Not even close!
Rino wants to deliver her song to even more people,
far beyond this.
m920191.分かりました。\n――それじゃあ王子、リノさん、\n最後まで楽しんでいってくださ:
Understood.
――Then, Prince, Rino,
please enjoy the rest of the show!
m920191.千年先まで、輝く未来を！\nみんな、リノについてきてー！！:
A future that shines for a thousand years!
Everyone, follow Rino――!!
m920191.召喚獣が、召喚士の想いに応えてるの？\nみんなを守りたいって気持ちに……。:
Is the summon beast responding to the summoner's feelings?
To the desire to protect everyone……
m920191.可愛く生まれて、可愛く生きるからには、\n可愛いをみんなに届けなくちゃね！:
Since we were born cute and live cutely,
we have to deliver cuteness to everyone!
m920191.吟遊詩人も、ダンサーも、アイドルも同じ。\n消えない輝きを誰かの魂に刻んでこそ、:
Bards, dancers, and idols are all the same.
Only by etching a light that never fades into someone's soul
can you truly call yourself an artist.
m920191.大丈夫です！\nこれはリハーサルですから、\n楽しむつもりで行きましょう！:
It's okay!
This is just a rehearsal, so
let's go in there and have fun!
m920191.大丈夫にするのは、リノさん自身です！\n王子たちも来てくれていますし、\n最高の:
It's up to you, Rino, to make it a success!
The Princes are here to support you, too,
so let's make this the best debut live show ever!
--- scene: First Live Show! (battle, battle) ---
m920191.届いたとも……。\nくっ……なんだ、この感情の正体は……。:
It did…….
Tch……what is this feeling I'm having……
m920191.師匠がいいからだよぉ。\nありがとね、ミヤビ！:
It's because you're a great teacher.
Thanks, Miyabi!
m920191.強敵との戦いにも劣らぬ、\nなんと美しく、心躍る歌……！:
A song as beautiful and thrilling
as a battle against a formidable foe……!
m920191.彼女コソ、王国軍の精鋭として名高き召喚士、\nソシテ巨躯のオークたちをも涙させタ:
She is none other than the renowned summoner of the Royal Army's elite,
the one who brought even the Giant-bodied Orcs to tears,
a super Millennium War-class idol—!!
m920191.待ってた……この日をずっと待ってた……。\nこれが俺たちのアイドル黄金時代……！:
I've been waiting…… I've been waiting for this day all along……
This is the golden age of our idol……!!
m920191.心震わす歌があることは否定しませんが、\nアイドル如きに、そんな力があるはずもな:
I won't deny that their songs can move the heart,
but there's no way something as trivial as an idol has that kind of power.
m920191.応援しろ、感謝を捧げろ！\n己の感情に素直になるがいい！！:
Cheer for her! Offer your gratitude!
Be honest with your own feelings!!
m920191.怪我がないどころか、\n魔物に一撃カマしてやりましたぞ！\nふんっ、ふんっ、全盛:
Not only are we unharmed,
we landed a blow on the monsters!
Huff, puff, I feel like I'm back in my prime!
m920191.恋でも、愛でもない……。\n戦場で好敵手に向けるそれでもない……。\nこの、ふわ:
It isn't love, nor is it affection……
It isn't the respect I have for a worthy rival on the battlefield……
This fluttering, heart-pounding sensation……
m920191.我が事務所のエス★エフの踏み台になってもらいますよ。\n魔導スピーカーにも細工を:
I'll be making you a stepping stone for my agency's E★F.
Let me just tamper with the magic speaker a bit...
Kukuku, all that's left is to stage an accident on the stage...
m920191.我らが、真の戦いというものを教えてやるぞ！\n全軍、王国軍を迎え撃てぇ！！:
We shall teach them what a true battle is!
All units, engage the Kingdom's army!!
m920191.我らゴブリンプリンセス三姉妹！\n――あなたを、ゴブリンにしてあげる♪:
We, the Goblin Princess Sisters of Three!
—We'll turn you into a Goblin♪
m920191.戦傷を負うと、興奮してウォークライを放ち始める。\nあれはもはや叫びではない、衝:
When they get wounded in battle, they get excited and start letting out war cries.
That's no longer just a shout; it's close to a shockwave!
m920191.政務官殿！ すぐに避難してください！\nライブは中止です！ 今すぐ安全な場所に！:
Your Excellency! Please evacuate immediately!
The live show is being cancelled! Get to a safe location, now!
m920191.明日のことなんて考えない！\n全力全開サラマンダー！\n今を完全燃焼しちゃうよ、:
Let's forget about tomorrow!
Full-power Salamander!
Let's burn bright in this very moment, everyone!
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m920191.歌は、軟弱なものなんかじゃない。\n巨躯のオークさんたちにも、きっと届く、よね。:
Music isn't something weak or fragile.
It must have reached the Giant Orcs, too, right?
m920191.泣くなよ、新入り……。\nアンナちゃんは政務官が本職なんだ。\nでもきっと、帰っ:
Don't cry, newbie……
Being the Chief of Administration is Anna-chan's main job.
But I'm sure she'll come back to us……!
m920191.炎の……サラマンダーの声を……。\nサラマンダーは、リノに、戦うだけじゃなくて、:
The voice of the flames…… the Salamander's voice…….
The Salamander is telling me, Rino, to do more than just fight,
to give strength to everyone…….
m920191.王国の戦士たちよ、気をつけよ。\n巨躯の村の連中は我らよりも力も体力も強い。:
Warriors of the Kingdom, be careful.
The ones from the Giant Orc village are stronger and more durable than us.
m920191.王子、ミヤビ、リノ頑張るね！: Prince, Miyabi, Rino's gonna do her best!
m920191.王子、ミヤビ、一緒にフェスに出よ！！: Prince, Miyabi, let's go to the festival together!!
m920191.王子、一緒についてきてくれてありがとね。\nやっぱりこういうの、ひとりじゃ不安で:
Thanks for coming with me, Prince.
I was really nervous about coming here alone.
m920191.王子、歌で興奮した観客は\n普段以上の力を発揮してくるはずです。\n油断せず、丁:
Prince, the audience, stirred up by the music,
should be putting out more power than usual.
Don't let your guard down, and please return them to their seats politely!
m920191.王子とミヤビ、それに皆のおかげだよ。\nはぁ、ライブ楽しかったなぁ……♪:
It's all thanks to the Prince, Miyabi, and everyone else.
Haa, that live was so much fun……♪
m920191.王子は忙しいから、誘うかどうか\nずっと悩んでいたんです。\nでも、こうして来て:
I kept worrying about whether to invite you,
since you're so busy.
But seeing you here, I'm truly――
m920191.王子ヨ、プリンセスたちの魅力ヲ！\n直接王国へ届けにきたゾ……！！:
Prince! We have come to deliver
the charm of the Princesses directly to the Kingdom…!!
m920191.皆も、まだまだ足りないって言ってますよ。\nもっとボクらの歌、聴きたいですよねー:
Everyone else is saying the same thing.
They want to hear more of our song, right?!
m920191.私みたいなダンサーでも、吟遊詩人でもなく、\n歌って踊れるアイドルですか……。: An idol who can sing and dance, even though I'm just a dancer like myself and not a bard……
m920191.素材がいいからだと思うんですけどねぇ……。\nふふ、それにしても、\nアイドルに:
I suppose it helps that you're a natural, though……
Heh, still, I was quite surprised
when you told me you wanted to be an idol.
m920191.素直になれ、商売人。\n歌は、あの娘の歌は、魂を震わせる歌だ。:
Face the truth, merchant.
That song—her song—shakes the very soul.
m920191.腕利きの戦士揃いと名高い王国軍、\nそして同族たる我らが、あいどるのらいぶ、\n: They must have been put off by the fact that the Kingdom's army, renowned for its elite warriors, and we of their own kind, were enjoying an "idol live."
m920191.魔物が警備網を突破しました！\nもう時間がありません！:
The monsters have breached the security perimeter!
There's no more time!
m920191.（さぁ、魔導スピーカーの仕込みを作動させましょう。\nこんなライブなど、ここで終:
(Alright, let's activate the rigged magic speakers.
A live performance like this ends right here—)
m920191.（すごい、観客がこんなにいっぱい……。\nみんな、アイドルが、歌が、この輝きが大:
(Wow, there are so many people here…
Everyone loves idols, loves singing, loves this radiance.)
m920191.（もっともっと輝きたい。\n伝説のアイドル、アンナさんみたいに！）:
(I want to shine even brighter.
Just like the legendary idol, Anna!)
m920191.（アイドル如きが、いったい何を……。\nいえ、お手並み拝見と行きましょうか。\n:
(What could an idol possibly do...
No, let's just see what you've got.
My cold, calculating heart is immune to any song.)
m920191.（ククク、魔導スピーカーの細工はバレていない……。\nデーモンシェフ様、今度こそ:
(Kukuku, the tampering with the magic speaker hasn't been noticed...
Chef Demon, this time I'll bring in a massive profit!
This Intelligent Demon will see it through...!!)
m920191.（フンッ……何がアイドルですか……。\nこんな胸の高鳴りなど、\n株価急上昇の興:
(Hmph… So this is what an idol is…
This kind of racing heartbeat, compared to
the thrill of a stock market surge…!)
m920191.（リノ、やったよ！\nリノもアイドルになれたよ！）:
(Rino did it!
Rino became an idol!)
m920191.（リノも……あんなふうに歌えたらな……）:
(I wish I could sing like that one day……)
--- scene: Aiming to Be an Idol ---
m920191.（リノもね、大好き。\n伝説のアイドル、アンナちゃんの輝きに憧れて、\nリノもこ:
(Rino loves it too.
Looking up to the legendary idol, Anna, and her brilliance,
Rino made it all the way to this stage…!)

m920229.――なんて、鳥人の里の方が\n大慌てで飛び込んできた時は心配しましたが。\nなる:
――Well, when the bird-folk from the village
rushed in in a panic, I was worried, but.
I see, the festival egg decorations really have been stolen.
m920229.――み、皆様！\nすみません、助けてくださいっ！:
―E-Everyone!
I'm so sorry, please help me!
m920229.――わかりました。\nそこまでいうなら、私が相手になります！:
―I understand.
If it comes to that, I will take it on myself!
m920229.――ガッハッハッハッハ！\n参った参ったァ！:
――Gahahaha!
You've got me! You really have me!
m920229.――ホウ、力比べか、\nなかなか面白そうなことをしているな。:
――Hoh, a test of strength, eh?
You're up to something rather interesting.
m920229.――兎が主役の\nぴょんぴょんばにー祭りなるものがあるらしいね。:
――I hear there's a “Bouncy Bunny Festival”
where rabbits are the stars of the show.
m920229.――猫さんを数日前に拾った？: ――You picked up a cat a few days ago?
m920229.……えっぐぱーてぃとかそんな名前じゃなかったか？: ……Wasn't it called something like the “Egg Party”?
m920229.……ここまで褒められると、照れてしまいますね。\nうふふっ、ありがとうございます:
……You're making me blush with all that praise.
Hehe, thank you, Luthier.
m920229.……もふもふもこもこで、ちょっと羨ましいかも。: ……All that fluff and fluffiness… I'm a little jealous, maybe.
m920229.……キャスパリーグ、\n無邪気だしもこもこだし、無理に倒さなくていいかも。: ……Caspar League is so innocent and fluffy… Maybe we don't have to force ourselves to take it down after all.
m920229.……確かに、そうかもしれないな。\nまぁ、倒すべきだと提言した手前、\n意見を変:
……You may be right.
I'm well aware that changing my mind now, after I was the one who recommended we subdue it, isn't ideal, but…
m920229.あ、ありがとうございますっ。\nそう言っていただけると、助かります……！:
Oh, thank you.
It really helps to hear you say that…!
m920229.あ、アナベラさん……！\nありがとうございますっ！:
Oh, Anabella…!
Thank you so much!
m920229.あぁ……猫の魔物さんたちが去っていく……。: Ah… the cat monsters are leaving…
m920229.あぁ、本当ですね……。\nでは落ち着いたら、手入れをお願いしちゃいましょうか。:
Ah, you're right…
Well, once we've settled in, I'll have to ask you to groom me.
m920229.あっ！ あれは盗まれた卵飾りですわ！\nそれに……ね、猫ちゃんが大量にいますわー:
Ah! Those are the stolen egg decorations!
And… oh my, there are so many cats here!
m920229.あと、この場にはいませんがジタリスさんも……。\n――おや？ あそこにあるのは…:
And, though he isn't here right now, Gitalis is…
―Oh my? What is that over there…?
m920229.あの……あなたはどちらかというと、\n奉納される側では……？: Um…… you're more on the side of being the one receiving the tribute, aren't you?
m920229.あのー……。\nジタリスさんが拾ったっていう猫なんですけど……。:
Um…
This is the cat that Gitalis picked up…
m920229.あの感じ、ついて来てって言ってるみたいだった。\n遊び場を変えたいってことかも…:
From the way it did it, it looked like it was telling us to follow.
Maybe it wants to change its play area…
m920229.あの時の勇敢なる人類か、久しいな。\n天の岩戸の外が騒がしくて来てみれば、\n奉:
The brave humans from that day, it's been a while.
I heard it was noisy outside the Heavenly Rock Cave,
and I see you're holding a tribute exhibition match.
m920229.いえ、これはたぶん、\nじゃれつこうとしているだけだと思います。:
No, I think it's just
trying to play with us.
m920229.いきなり玉兎を召喚しやがった！？\nまさか、神獣と俺たちを戦わせるつもりか！:
You just summoned Gyokuto out of nowhere?!
You're not actually planning to pit a Divine Beast against us, are you?
m920229.いずれにしても、ジタリスさんが連れて行かれた以上、\nこのまま放っておくわけには:
Either way, since it took Gitalis with it,
we can't just leave them there.
m920229.いや、でも戦ったおかげなのか、\nなんだか嬉しそうに見えますよ……？:
No, but maybe it's because we fought it…
It actually looks pretty happy, don't you think?
m920229.いやいや、まさかそんなに大きくなっているわけ……。: No, no, surely it can't have gotten that big…
m920229.うふふっ、この子ったら王子様が大好きみたいですね。\nはやく遊んで欲しいって言っ:
Hehe, this little one seems to adore the Prince.
It looks like it's begging to play right away.
m920229.うん、さすが王子！\nキャスパリーグが来ても問題ないってさ！:
Yes, just like the Prince!
It's no problem even if Caspar League shows up!
m920229.うん、そうだね。\n悪さをしたご先祖さまとは別の子だもん。\n同じようになるとは:
Yeah, I think so too.
It's a different child from its mischievous ancestors.
It doesn't have to turn out the same way.
m920229.えぇ、とってももふもふですよ。\nリュティエさんがすっぽり埋まるくらいには。:
Yes, it's incredibly fluffy.
Fluffy enough for you to sink right into it, Luthier.
m920229.えぇ、分かりましたっ。\nうふふっ、リュティエさんとエクスさんと、\n一緒に戦え:
Yes, of course.
Hehe, I'm so happy to be fighting alongside you, Luthier, and Aix!
m920229.えぇ、絶対に。\n私が主治医として、そして親代わりとして、\n怪物にならないよう:
Yes, absolutely.
As its doctor and as a sort of parent,
I'll make sure it never becomes a monster.
m920229.えぇっ！？ もうそんな時間！？\n大変だ、早く会場に向かわないと！:
Ehh!? It's already that time!?
Oh no, I have to get to the venue quickly!
m920229.えっ、はい。\nリュティエさんは上手そうですし、\n私も人に梳いてもらう方が好き:
Huh? Yes.
You seem skilled at it, Luthier,
and I prefer having someone else groom me anyway.
m920229.えっ、ボクが触っちゃっていいの！？: Huh? You want me to do it!?
m920229.おっと、そろそろ出番だ！\nみんな、かっこいいところみせるよ！:
Oh, my turn is coming up!
Everyone, I'm going to show you all how cool I am!
m920229.かの神々を、見事に討ち取ってみせたか。: You have managed to defeat those gods.
m920229.こうして王子様と仲良くしている姿を見ると、\nきっとこの子は大丈夫だって、そう思:
Seeing it get along so well with the Prince,
I truly believe this one will be all right.
m920229.この子は、私の患者です。\nだからこそ、守り通させていただきます！:
This is my patient.
And as such, I will protect it to the end!
m920229.これからは、人の時代、か――。: From now on, it shall be the age of humans――.
m920229.これだけ人に懐ているなら、\n無理に討伐する必要もないのかもしれないな。\nもち:
If it's grown this attached to people,
perhaps there really is no need to hunt it down.
Of course, we'll still need to keep a close eye on it.
m920229.これは……まさか妖猫キャスパリーグか？: Could this be… the demon cat, Caspar League?
m920229.これより、エッグパーティのメインイベント、\n王国軍を交えての模擬戦をとりおこな:
And now, for the main event of the Egg Party,
we shall hold a mock battle involving the Royal Army!
m920229.こんな巨体でじゃれつかれたら\n襲われてるのと同じですよ……！？:
Being pounced on by something that size
is the same as being attacked…!
m920229.さぁ、アメノタヂカラ様も交えて、\n奉納模擬戦、もとい奉納相撲をはじめるよ！:
Now then, with Ameno Tajikara joining us,
let's begin the tribute exhibition match! Or, rather, the tribute sumo match!
m920229.しかもあの子は猫の魔物たちとも仲が良かったみたいで、\n影響された猫たちが真似を:
On top of that, it seems it got along well with the cat monsters,
and the ones who were influenced by it started copying it…
m920229.すごい！ もふもふだよ！\n猫の魔物さんたちで一面もふもふの楽園じゃん！:
Amazing! They're so fluffy!
It's like a fluffy paradise made of cat monsters!
m920229.すごくもふもふでとっても可愛いけど、\nただの猫さんではないことは確かだと思うよ:
It's incredibly fluffy and adorable, but
I think it's safe to say it's not just a regular cat!
m920229.せ、成長している……？\nそれっていいことなんじゃないの？:
G-Growing fast…?
Isn't that a good thing?
m920229.せっかくだ、オレも混ぜてもらおう！\nフン！ フン！ ドスコーイ！:
Since I'm here, count me in!
Hmph! Hmph! Doskoi!
m920229.そういえばそうだっけ。\nなら、ボクもジタリスと一緒に戦えて嬉しいよ！:
Now that you mention it, that's true.
In that case, I'm happy to fight on your side, Gitalis!
m920229.そうだね、キャスパリーグを追いかけよう！: Right, let's go after Caspar League!
m920229.そうですね……あっ！駄目ですよっ。\nまた卵飾りを持っていったら！:
I suppose so…… Ah! No, that won't do.
It's gone off with the egg decorations again!
m920229.そうなんですけど、普通じゃないといいますか……。\nいえ、たぶん直接見てもらった:
It is, but it's not quite normal, if you know what I mean…
No, I think it's best if you just see for yourself.
m920229.その上でも神殺しとして驕ることなく、\n古き神々相手に、\nこうして奉納相撲まで:
And yet, despite your reputation as a god-slayer,
you have not grown arrogant.
You even go so far as to perform a tribute sumo match
against the ancient gods.
m920229.その子は日に日に回復していったのですが、\n元気になるにつれて活発になって……。:
It's been getting better day by day, but
as it regained its strength, it's become quite lively…
m920229.その怪物の名が、キャスパリーグ。\nおそらく目の前にいるのは、\n大昔に退治され:
That monster is known as Caspar League.
The one before us is likely a descendant of the individual that was slain long ago.
m920229.それじゃあ、卵飾り持って会場に戻ろうか！\nエッグパーティの準備をしなきゃだもん:
Well then, let's head back to the venue with the egg decorations!
We still have to prepare for the Egg Party!
m920229.それで久しぶりに外に出たところ、\n丸い物……卵飾りを気に入ったらしく、\n住処:
So, when I let it outside for the first time in a while,
it seemed to take a liking to round objects… the egg decorations,
and it carried them off to its new home.
m920229.それで結局、キャスパリーグはどうなったの？: So, what happened with Caspar League in the end?
m920229.それと、お手入れ道具を貸すよ。\nほら、キャスパリーグにじゃれつかれて、\nつや:
Also, I'll lend you some grooming tools.
Look, Caspar League has been playing with you,
and your sleek feathers are all ruffled.
m920229.それに、キャスパリーグも\nジタリスと一緒に遊べて嬉しそうだったよ！\nだから良:
And besides, Caspar League seemed so happy
to play with Gitalis!
So I think it all turned out well!
m920229.それはそうだが、\nこの子がずっとアスガルドにとどまってくれるとも限らない。\n:
That may be true, but
there's no guarantee this one will stay in Asgard forever.
It could pose a danger to the Avian Village as well…
m920229.それもあるのですが……。\n拾ったあの子はなんというか、すごく成長しているんです:
That's part of it, but…
the one I picked up is, well, growing really fast.
m920229.そんなことないって！\nつやつやでぴかぴかだし、とっても綺麗だし！\nなんていう:
They're not!
They're so sleek and shiny, and really beautiful!
It's just… they're incredibly majestic!
m920229.そんなのダメだよ！\nせっかく兎さんの可愛い格好してるんだから、\n卵を取り戻し:
No way!
Since I'm dressed up so cutely as a bunny,
we have to get the eggs back and make it a fun Egg Party!
m920229.たいへんです！\nエッグパーティの卵飾りが盗まれてしまいました！:
This is bad!
The Egg Party decorations have been stolen!
m920229.ただあの子は、\n模擬戦が大好きになっちゃったみたいで――: It's just that the little one has become absolutely obsessed with mock battles――
m920229.だから今は、この子も含めて、\nエッグパーティを楽しみましょう♪:
So for now, let's enjoy the Egg Party,
this little one included♪
m920229.だけどこんなに可愛い子が\n将来都市を滅ぼすような魔物になるなんて、\nそんなの:
But the thought of such a cute little one
growing up to be a monster that could destroy a city…
That would be a shame for Caspar League too!
m920229.だとしても駄目です！\n悪さをしたのはご先祖さまで、この子には罪はありません！:
I can't allow that!
It was its ancestors who caused the trouble, not this one!
m920229.ていうかこっちに襲いかかろうとしていない！？: And isn't it trying to attack us right now?!
m920229.で、でしたら後で撫でてみてはいかがでしょう……？\nこの子も、皆様のことを気に入:
W-Why don't you try petting it later…?
It seems to have taken a liking to all of you…
It should let you pet it easily!
m920229.でしたら近寄ってそっと起こして追い払いましょう\nとにかく平和的に、卵飾りを回収:
In that case, let's approach them gently, wake them up, and shoo them away.
We'll retrieve the decorations peacefully, no matter what.
m920229.ですが、どのみち落ち着かせる必要はありますわ！\n遊びたがりなキャスパリーグが来:
But we still need to calm it down!
Caspar League is a playful sort!
m920229.ですが、満足してもらえたようで良かったです！\n皆さんのおかげで、上手く奉納でき:
But I'm glad you seem satisfied!
Thanks to everyone, the tribute went off without a hitch!
m920229.でも、そろそろエッグパーティがはじまるわ。\nイヨは行かなくていいの？\n卵をた:
But the Egg Party is about to start.
Aren't you going?
You were so excited about finding lots of eggs, weren't you?
m920229.でもあんなに可愛い猫さん、\n遠距離攻撃で無理やり起こすなんて絶対にできないよ！:
But those cats are so adorable,
there's no way I could force them awake with a ranged attack!
m920229.でもエクス、とっても似合ってるって！\nどこからどう見ても可愛い兎さんだよ！:
But, Aix, it really suits you!
No matter how you look at it, you're an adorable bunny!
m920229.というか、自然にこの子と一緒に戦ってしまいました……！\nみ、皆様っ、大丈夫でし:
Besides, we ended up fighting alongside it naturally…!
E-Everyone… are you all alright…!?
m920229.というわけで、我が前にいでよ、\n大いなる鏡像――神獣「玉兎」っ！！:
So come before me,
great mirror image――Divine Beast, “Gyokuto”!!
m920229.というわけで、王国らしく奉納模擬戦をみんなでやろうよ！: So let's all put on a proper royal tribute exhibition match!
m920229.とっても喜んでるみたいだし、\nそれにこんな無邪気な姿を見せられたら、\n倒そう:
It really does seem to be enjoying itself.
And seeing such an innocent side of it…
It makes it hard to bring yourself to defeat it…
m920229.とっても嬉しそうだね。\nそれにジタリスの言うこともちゃんと聞いてるし、\nこの:
It looks so happy.
And it's listening to what Gitalis says, too,
so I don't think it's likely to cause any trouble.
m920229.とはいえ今は模擬戦の最中ですし、\nこの子の相手をしてあげられるかは……。:
That said, we are in the middle of a mock battle,
so I'm not sure if I can spare the time to look after it…
m920229.とんでもないものを拾ってきましたねー！？: You really picked up quite the trouble, didn't you…?
m920229.どうやら、また遊んでもらいたくて\nここまで来たみたいですね。: It looks like it came all this way because it wants to play again.
m920229.どんどん上機嫌になっていますね……。\nもしかするとキャスパリーグは、\n私たち:
It's getting more and more cheerful…
Perhaps Caspar League thinks we're playing with it.
m920229.なら満足させてあげないとね！\nキャスパリーグたちの相手も頼んだよ！:
Then we'll have to make sure you're satisfied!
I'm counting on you to take on Caspar League and the others too!
m920229.なるほど、それで猫の群れが\n卵飾りで遊んだりしていたのですね。:
I see. So that's why the swarm of cats
was playing with the egg decorations.
m920229.は、はい……じゃれつかれて、\nちょっとふらふらしますけど……。:
Y-Yes… It's been playing rough with me,
so I'm a little dizzy…
m920229.はぁ、はぁっ……。\n相変わらずの力自慢でしたわね……！:
Haa, haa…….
As always, you're just showing off your strength……!
m920229.はい、怪我をした子猫を見つけたので\n手当をして保護したんです。:
Yes, I found a kitten that was injured,
so I treated it and took it in.
m920229.ふっふっふ、祝祭に際して、\nうさぴょん……玉兎に奉納しよう思ってね。:
Fu fu fu, in honor of the festival,
I thought we'd offer a tribute to the bunny…… I mean, Gyokuto.
m920229.ふふ、大丈夫ですよ。\n誰も怪我なんてしていませんし。:
Hehe, we're fine.
No one got hurt, after all.
m920229.ふふっ、それは私も同じですよ。\nでは私たちで、王子様たちに挑みましょうか！:
Hehe, I feel the same way.
Then shall we challenge the Prince and the others ourselves!
m920229.ふーん、それで猫さんが大変だー、\nって助けを求めにきたってことかな。: Hm, so you came asking for help because things got out of hand with the cats.
m920229.ほ、本当に触っちゃっていいの？\n鳥人さんの羽に触るなんて恐れ多すぎるんだけど！:
R-Really? I can touch them?
It's a bit terrifying to touch a bird-person's feathers!
m920229.ほ、褒めていただけるのは嬉しいのですが……！\nそれを言うならリュティエさんこそ:
W-Well, I appreciate the compliment, but…!
If anything, Luthier, you're the one who really knows how to pull off an outfit. It looks wonderful on you.
m920229.ほら、今回の騒動では、\nおふたりと戦ってばかりでしたから……。: Well, considering all the trouble recently, I've been fighting against you two the whole time…
m920229.まぁ、うさぴょんも楽しそうだったし奉納は大成功だね！: Well, Bunny Hop seemed to have a great time, so the tribute was a huge success!
m920229.まだ興奮していますけど、\nこのまま遊んであげたら落ち着きそう――きゃっ！？:
It's still quite worked up, but
if we keep playing with it, it should calm down—Kyaa!?
m920229.み、皆様……。\nどうやら、この子は成体になったみたいです……。\nその、ちょう:
E-Everyone…
It looks like this one has reached its adult form…
It was right in the middle of its growth spurt, I suppose…
m920229.も、もう、そんなに身を寄せなくても、\nどこかに行ったりしませんから……！:
N-Now, you don't have to cling to me that much,
I'm not going anywhere…!
m920229.もちろんですっ。\nお手数をおかけしますが、皆様よろしくお願いします！:
Of course!
I'm sorry for the trouble, but please take care of this for us!
m920229.もちろん私たちが、\n都市を滅ぼすような怪物にならないよう、\nしっかり面倒を見:
Of course, we still need to keep a close eye on it
to make sure it doesn't become a monster that could destroy the city……
m920229.よく分かりませんが、\nどのみち卵飾りは取り戻さなければいけませんし、\n案内を:
I don't quite follow, but
either way, we need to retrieve the egg decorations.
Could you show us the way?
m920229.ら、来年の奉納は、祭りのイベントに組み込んでもらおう！\nみんなー！ 会場に急げ:
L-let's include next year's tribute in the festival events!
Everyone! Hurry to the venue!!
m920229.アナベラさん！\nもしかして何かご存じなんですか？:
Anabella!
Do you know something about this?
m920229.キャスパリーグ……！？\nそれに猫の魔物たちまで……！:
Caspar League…!?
And cat monsters too…!
m920229.キャスパリーグ、遊び疲れたのか寝ちゃったね。: Caspar League must have played itself tired. It's fallen asleep.
m920229.キャスパリーグが、\nジタリスさんを咥えてどこかへ行ってしまいました……！:
Caspar League has
bit Gitalis and carried them off somewhere…!
m920229.キャスパリーグたちも満足したようですし、\n模擬戦はここまでですわね。:
It seems Caspar League and the others are satisfied,
so let's call it a day.
m920229.キャスパリーグは大はしゃぎだね。\nこれはボクたちのことを、完全に遊び相手だと思:
Caspar League is having a blast.
It clearly thinks we're its playmates now!
m920229.キャスパリーグは本当に卵飾りが気に入ったのですね。\n今は祝祭の最中ですから渡せ:
It really does love the egg decorations, doesn't it.
We can't give them to it while the festival is in full swing,
but how about we share a few eggs with it once it's over?
m920229.キャスパリーグも！？\nもふもふに触れるのは嬉しいけど、\n嬉しすぎて感情が爆発:
Caspar League too!?
I'm happy to touch something so fluffy,
but I'm so happy my feelings are going to explode!
m920229.ジタリス？ どうしてここに……。\nていうか助けてって何があったの？:
Gitalis? Why are you here…?
And what's with "help me"? What happened?
m920229.リュティエさんが盛り上がっていますが……。\n卵飾りは里の子どもたちも参加し、\:
Luthier is getting quite excited, but…
The egg decorations were made by the village children, with love put into every single one.
m920229.リュティエさんほど素敵な人なら、\nあの子のブラッシングもお願いしちゃいましょう:
With someone as wonderful as you, Luthier, I suppose I can entrust you with brushing that little one too.
I did recommend you give it a stroke, after all♪
m920229.世界樹と同じく、鳥人の里もサンダーバードと縁深い場所。\nそれゆえに今年は天界で:
Just like the World Tree, the bird-folk's village is a place with deep ties to the Thunderbird.
That is why the Heavens have decided to host
an Egg Party this year, but…
m920229.今後も、頼りたくば頼るがよい。\nこれからは神としてでなく、\nひとりの隣人とし:
If you need my help in the future, feel free to ask.
From now on, not as a god,
but as a neighbor, I will lend you a hand.
m920229.伝承の中にこの猫とよく似た外見的特徴を持つ存在がいる。\nかつて英雄王が戦い、退:
There is a being in the legends that closely resembles this cat.
It was a monstrous feline that the Hero King once fought and defeated.
m920229.何はともあれ、卵飾りはある程度取り戻せました。\n全部はここにありませんでしたが:
In any case, we managed to recover a fair number of the egg decorations.
Not all of them were here, though.
They're probably being hidden by the rest of the cat monster swarm.
m920229.兎の格好は関係ないと思うのですが……。\nというかこの装いは可愛いというより、\:
I don't think the bunny outfit has anything to do with it, though…
Honestly, this costume feels less "cute" and more a bit embarrassing, if you ask me?
m920229.卵飾りがなくなったとなると、\n少々味気ない祝祭になってしまいそうですね。:
With the egg decorations missing,
the festival is going to feel a bit bland, I'm afraid.
m920229.卵飾りでテンションが上がったのか、\n少し興奮しているようだな。\n落ち着かせな:
It seems to be getting worked up over the egg decorations.
We won't be able to contain it until it calms down.
m920229.可哀想ではあるが……。\n幼体のうちに倒しておくべきだろう。:
It's a pity, but…
we should probably defeat it while it's still young.
m920229.可愛い猫の魔物さんたちも間近で見れたし、\n最高の一時だったよ！:
We got to see those cute cat monsters up close, too.
It was the best time ever!
m920229.子どもと遊びたいお父さんみたいだ。\nこれは相手してあげるしかなさそうだね。:
You look like a dad who wants to play with his kids.
I suppose I'll have to oblige.
m920229.完全にジタリスさんをお母さんだと思っているようで、\n人を襲ったりすることもなく:
It seems to think Gitalis is its mother completely.
It doesn't attack anyone; if anything, it's guarding the Bird-Folk Village like a watchdog… or a watchcat?
m920229.尋常じゃなく懐かれていますね。\nあの調子だと、キャスパリーグから離すのは無理で:
It's attached to you in an unusual way.
At this rate, it'll be impossible to separate it from Caspar League.
m920229.怪我が治るまで安静にさせていましたから。\n完治したとはいえ、体力がついてこなか:
Oh, yes.
You seem to be good at it, Luthier,
and I actually prefer having someone else groom me.
m920229.成長した猫さんかぁ……。\nきっとすごくもふもふなんだろうなぁ。:
A grown-up cat, huh…
It's probably really fluffy, I bet.
m920229.猫……いえ、魔物でしょうか？\n卵飾りを持って、遊んでいるように見えますね。:
Cats… or perhaps, monsters?
They seem to be playing with the egg decorations.
m920229.猫が、大変なことになっているんですっ！: The cats are in terrible trouble!
m920229.猫さんには可哀想ですが、卵飾りを取り返した後には、\n別の卵をプレゼントすること:
It's a shame for the cats, but after we retrieve the decorations,
let's promise to give them some other eggs as a gift.
m920229.猫の魔物たちを追えば、きっと残りも回収できるはずです。\nですからこのまま群れを:
If we track the cat monsters, we should be able to retrieve the rest.
So, let's keep following the swarm and―
m920229.獣医も首を傾げていましたし、\nやっぱりこの子って、ただの猫じゃないですよね……:
Even the veterinarian was baffled by it.
So this one really isn't just an ordinary cat, is it…?
m920229.申し訳ありません、皆様。\n私は、この子を倒すことに同意できません。:
I'm sorry, everyone.
I cannot agree to having this one defeated.
m920229.細かいことはどうでもいいよ！\n重要なのは、兎が主役だってことだよ！:
I don't care about the details!
What matters is that rabbits are the main attraction!
m920229.英雄王が倒したキャスパリーグは、\n都市ひとつを壊滅させるほどの怪物に育ったと聞:
I've heard that the Caspar League the Hero King defeated
grew into a monster capable of destroying an entire city.
m920229.落ち着かせるためには、\n遊び疲れるまで付き合うしかなさそうですね……！:
To calm it down, it looks like we'll have to play with it
until it's tired…!
m920229.身体が猫とは思えないほど大きいですし、\n外見も私の知るそれとは違うように見えま: It's far too large to be a cat, and its appearance is quite different from any I've seen before…!
m920229.追いついてみたはいいですが……。\nキャスパリーグが大きくなっていませんか？:
We caught up, but…
Hasn't Caspar League gotten bigger?
m920229.（アマツちゃん、いい空気を吸ってますね……）: (Amatsu-chan is really enjoying the fresh air……)

m930023.……うん、いい感じの情報だね。\nこれだけあればドウマンの動きを割り出せる。\n:
……Yeah, this looks like some good intel.
With this much, we should be able to figure out Douman's movements.
Let's just copy the important parts and put everything back where it was.
m930023.……こほん、お前たちは包囲されている。\n大人しく投降するのであれば命までは取ら:
……Ahem. You are surrounded.
If you surrender quietly, I will spare your lives.
Lord Douman will surely forgive you as well.
m930023.……そう、あなたも付喪神になったのね。: ……I see. So you've become a tsukumogami, too.
m930023.……そっか、それじゃあ巻き込んじゃおっかな。: ……Right, I guess I can't leave you out of this.
m930023.……ふむ、腐っても天下人の娘か。: ……I see. Even in decline, she is the daughter of a ruler of the realm.
m930023.……また、全部押し付ける気か。: ……You're trying to dump it all on me again, aren't you.
m930023.……ものすごーく簡単に省略して説明すると、\n公衆の面前で面子と矜持と尊厳を潰し:
……If I had to explain it in the simplest terms possible,
I probably crushed his face, pride, and dignity in front of everyone.
m930023.……よし、式神対策は彼女たちに任せようか。: ……Very well. I'll leave the shikigami countermeasures to them.
m930023.……よろしいので？:
Honestly, I quite like Norimochi.
It's rare these days to find a lord with so little pretense.
m930023.……人間の善性を信じる努力はしときたいじゃん？: ...I'd like to make the effort to believe in human goodness, if only for a little.
m930023.──ああもうっ！ なにしてくれてんの！: ──Oh, come on! What are you doing!
m930023.──ここらで今までの流れを振り返ってみよう！: ──Let's take a moment to recap where things stand!
m930023.──チヨメ、やることは分かってるわね。: ──Chiyome, you know what to do, right?
m930023.──妖怪に与する逆賊を殺せ！: ──Kill the rebels who consort with demons!
m930023.──恐れながら国主代理ヨシノ、御前に参上仕りました。: ──With all due respect, I, Yoshino, acting head of state, have come before you.
m930023.──控えられよ、政務官殿。\n帝はヨシノと話しておられる。\nいくら王国とて無礼:
──Hold your tongue, Chancellor.
The Emperor is speaking with Yoshino.
Such rudeness is unacceptable, even for the Kingdom.
m930023.──雨が止む前に、終わらせまする。: ──I'll end this before the rain stops.
m930023.ああ、兵部卿でしたか。\n夜分遅くまでお疲れ様です。\nこんな時間にどうされまし:
Ah, the Minister of the Military Affairs Ministry.
You've been working late again.
What brings you out at this hour?
m930023.ああでも、次やったら磯辺焼きね？: Ah, but next time, we're doing grilled seaweed, okay?
m930023.ああ？ 客なんているわけ──: Huh? A visitor? There's no way──
m930023.あの、敵に見つかったら？: Um, what if we get spotted by the guards?
m930023.あらすご……いや、さすがに誤魔化しきれないでしょ。: Oh, that's quite something…… No, I suppose it's a bit too obvious to pass as the truth.
m930023.あれに捕まったら終わりなことぐらい分かるでしょ！: Surely you know that getting caught by them means it's over!
m930023.あんたが死んだってどうせ戦になるわよ！\n私が野蛮な侍連中をまとめられるとでも！:
Even if you died, it would still lead to war!
As if I could keep a group of barbaric samurai in line!
m930023.あー、それは大変ですね。\nドウマン様も人使いが荒い。:
Ah, that sounds like a lot.
Douman-sama really wears his people out.
m930023.いえ、それが、奴の気迫に将兵たちが気圧され……。: I…… well, his presence was so overwhelming that the soldiers were paralyzed……
m930023.いざ征かん、権謀術数乱れし伏魔殿──朝廷へ。: Onward, then, to the Fuma-den, the court where schemes and stratagems run wild.
m930023.いずれは全国の守護地頭も式神に置き換える気だ。\nそうすれば軍事力を武家に頼る必:
Eventually, he plans to replace the guardians of all the provinces with shikigami.
That way, he won't have to rely on the warrior class for military power.
m930023.いやー、ドウマン様から明日朝一で\nヨシノの追撃隊を出せって言われてさ。: Well, Douman-sama ordered me to send Yoshino's pursuit squad out first thing tomorrow morning.
m930023.うぅ、こんな夜中にどうやって探せってんだよぅ！\n沓はずぶ濡れだし、お腹は空いた:
Ugh, how am I supposed to find you in the middle of the night?
My geta are soaked, my stomach is growling, and I want to go home…!
m930023.うっうっ、公家のご先祖様ごめんなさい……。: Ugh, I'm so sorry to the ancestors of the nobility……
m930023.うむ、最後に会ったのは十年以上前か。\n積もる話もあるが先に本題に入るとしよう。:
Mm. It's been over ten years since we last met.
There's a lot to catch up on, but let's get straight to business.
I have a favor to ask of you warriors.
m930023.うるせぇ！ ここは任せて早く尻尾巻いて逃げやがれ！:
At least you're fast on your feet, huh!
Come on, wild child!
m930023.うん、ありがとう──それと、ごめんね？: Yeah, thanks──Oh, and, sorry about this?
m930023.うん、昔からの知り合い。\nそう頻繁に会ってたわけじゃないけど、\n大きな行事と:
Yes, we've known each other for a long time.
We didn't see each other often,
but we'd always run into each other at big events.
m930023.ええ、どうせ足が動かないもの。やってちょうだい。: Yes, please. I can't move my legs anyway. Do your best.
m930023.おおおおおっ、脅そうとしたって無駄だぞ！:
Grrr... Don't think you can intimidate me!
I'm the Minister of War now, you know!
Don't treat me like the same old me!
m930023.おかげさまで内戦確定だよまったく！\n私の首で収まるならそれでよかったのに！:
Thanks to you, a civil war is now a certainty!
If it could have been settled with just my head, that would have been fine!
m930023.おそらく内裏はドウマンの操る式神だらけでしょう、\nその警備網を突破し彼奴の首を:
The Imperial Palace is likely swarming with shikigami under Douman's control.
Breaking through that security net to take his head would be an incredibly difficult feat.
m930023.おばけだ！ みんな叩いて追い出せ！: A ghost! Everyone, beat it away!
m930023.お二人ともー、まずは逃げることを優先して──: Both of you, priority number one is to escape──
m930023.お前たちがぼくで遊んでたんだろぉ！？: You were the ones playing with me, weren't you?
m930023.お前たちはぼくが嫌いなの！？ それとも忠臣なの！？:
So, what will you do, Norimochi?
Will you sacrifice your loyal retainers, who have served your family for generations,
to keep your title as Minister of War, or—
m930023.お前たちはまだ言葉で教えて理解できる境地にない。\nゆえに、その身体に直接叩き込:
You are not yet at a stage where you can understand through words alone.
Therefore, I will drive the knowledge directly into your bodies. Understood?
m930023.お前たちぼくの部下だよなぁ！？: Shut up! We'll hold them off, so tail between your legs and run!
m930023.お待ちください、その結論はあまりに乱暴かと。: Please wait. That conclusion is far too hasty.
m930023.きみたち風に言うのなら、召喚獣ってところかな。\n彼らが陰陽師との合意に至るまで:
In your terms, you might call them summoned beasts.
The circumstances under which they reach an agreement with an onmyoji vary,
but Douman possesses the power to force yokai into submission.
m930023.けっ、決してそんなことは……。: K-Keep your voice down! It's not like that at all……
m930023.ここから何を探すのですか？: What are we looking for here?
m930023.ここでの討伐令は国に要らぬ混乱を生むだけかと。: I believe a cull order here would only bring unnecessary chaos to the nation.
m930023.ここにいる戦力だけでは、少し厳しいだろうね。\nとはいえ、応援を呼んでも次の朝議:
With the forces here, it will be a tight squeeze.
However, even if we call for reinforcements, they won't arrive in time for the next morning council.
By the time they reach us, you will all be officially declared enemies of the state.
m930023.この先、私たち武家が生き残る方法は二つ。: Going forward, there are only two ways for us warriors to survive.
m930023.この国と妖怪は不可分の存在だ。\nたとえ一時的に取り除けたとしても、\nまた新し:
This nation and the yokai are inseparable.
Even if we were to eliminate them for a time, new yokai would simply take their place.
m930023.この国において帝とは現人神、絶対の存在なんだ。\nしばらく不在だったからとその正:
In this country, the Emperor is a living god, an absolute presence.
His legitimacy remains unshaken, even after his absence.
m930023.この子の領地って小さい上に攻めやすくてさ、\nよく周りから喧嘩を売られがちだった:
Her territory is small and easy to attack, so she was always picking fights with her neighbors.
My father and I were always the ones stepping in to mediate, and yet—
m930023.これがいわゆる君側の奸ってやつでね、\nまだ幼い帝を騙してやりたい放題している。:
This is what's known as a "treacherous minister."
He's deceiving the young Emperor and doing whatever he pleases.
m930023.これは単純な比較の問題よ。\nどちらを生かした方が得なのか、\n自分の器の程度は:
It's a simple matter of comparison.
Which of us is more valuable to keep alive?
I know my own limitations.
m930023.これも世の常よな、殺せ。: Such is the way of the world. Kill her.
m930023.これより先、我が身は修羅道に入る！\n鬼を斬る覚悟もなければさっさと去ね！:
From this point on, I enter the path of the Asura!
If you lack the resolve to slay demons, get out of here!
m930023.これより拙者、シズカ殿にお味方申す。: From this moment, I pledge my blade to you, Lady Shizuka.
m930023.これを阻止するには、暗殺しかない。: To stop this, assassination is the only option.
m930023.こんな風に恩を仇で返すんだからさぁ……\nケジメをつけないと他に示しがつかないよ:
To repay that kindness with hostility...
I suppose I have no choice but to set an example for everyone else.
m930023.さて、まずは朝廷の方針から振り返ろう。\n彼らが主張する妖怪の討滅という目標だが:
Well then, let's start by looking back at the Imperial Court's policy.
Their stated goal of exterminating the yokai is, as you all know, practically impossible.
m930023.さてもさてもそこもとら、\nまさか今さら死にたくないなど、\nどうか言ってくださ:
Come now, come now, you there.
Please don't say something so foolish as "I don't want to die yet."
m930023.しょうがねぇよ、馬鹿でビビりだもん。: Let's take them all down in one go!
m930023.すみません、少しだけ放っておいてあげてください。: I'm sorry, but please just leave her alone for a moment.
m930023.そういうのが嫌だって話をしたかったんだけどなぁ。: I was hoping we could avoid that kind of talk.
m930023.その名乗りにその名前──\nまさか、あの妖刀ムラサメ……？:
That name, and that title……
Could it be…… the cursed blade Murasame?
m930023.その通り！ 我こそは兵部卿、ノリモチなり！: That's right! I am Norimochi, Minister of War!
m930023.そもそもうちの子じゃないわよ。: She's not even one of our people.
m930023.それが必要なのは貴様の方だ。: That's what you need to do.
m930023.それぞれの立場を強引に王国と置き換えるなら、\n帝が王子、公家がアンナさん、武家:
If we map their roles onto our Kingdom,
the Emperor would be like the Prince, the aristocracy like Lady Anna, and the warrior class like Lady Meireu?
m930023.それだけ期待されてるってことだと思うようにするよ。: I guess I'll just think of it as a sign that he has high expectations for me.
m930023.それで、ノリモチくんはどうするの？\n先代から仕えてくれている忠臣を犠牲にして\: I surrender! I'm surrendering! Please don't kill my men!
m930023.それで、早速ノリモチくんに頼みたいことがあって──: So, I have something I'd like to ask you to do right away, Norimochi──
m930023.それは拙者も探しておる最中なのですが……結構！: I am still searching for that answer myself…… But never mind!
m930023.それを決めるのは貴様ではなく帝よ。\n疑いが晴れるまで東に帰れると思うな。:
It is not for you to decide, but for the Emperor.
Do not think you can return to the East until the suspicion is cleared.
m930023.ちょ、やめなさい！ いたっ、痛いから！\n生きてる！ ちゃんとまだ生きてるってば: Hey, stop it! Ow, that hurts! I'm alive! I'm still very much alive!
m930023.ちょっと、この時間にどこに行く気よ？: Hey, where do you think you're going at this hour?
m930023.てんで駄目ね、公家の人材不足は深刻かしら。: You're hopeless. The court's talent shortage is serious, isn't it?
m930023.で、この現場をどうするかだけど。: So, what are we going to do about this scene?
m930023.で、今回の黒幕がこのドウマンっていう陰陽師。: And the mastermind behind all this is a Yin-Yang master named Douman.
m930023.では、ドウマンは何を考えているのか。\nあいつは妖怪を滅ぼしたいんじゃあない、\:
So, what is Douman thinking?
He doesn't want to destroy the yokai.
He wants to remake them into his shikigami.
m930023.ではでは、まず倒れている方々にこの針を打ちます。: Then, first, I'll give the unconscious ones this needle.
m930023.なぁに、通りすがりの浪人です。\nひとまずは拙者が前を受け持ちましょう。\nその:
Oh, I'm just a wandering ronin passing by.
Allow me to take the lead for a moment.
Use the time to catch your breath.
m930023.なっ、名前のことは言うな！ ばか！ ばーか！: D-don't you dare mention my name! You idiot! You big idiot!
m930023.ならばその善良な妖怪とやらを選び、\nそなたらの国へと持ち帰ればよろしい。\n儂:
Then select those benevolent yokai of yours
and take them back to your country.
We have no intention of pursuing them beyond our borders.
m930023.なんだいなんだい、幼馴染を化物みたいに。: What's the matter, treating your childhood friend like a monster?
m930023.はい、チクっとしますよー。: Alright, here goes a little prick!
m930023.はい、私たちも同行しましょう。\n何かお役に立てるかもしれません。:
Yes, we'll come along too.
We might be able to help.
m930023.はうあ！？: You idiot! You're acting like a nobleman!
m930023.はっ、はい！ 行くぞお前たち！: Y-Yes, sir! Move out, you lot!
m930023.はっはっは、敵が一人増えた程度で及び腰ですなぁ。: Hahaha, you're getting nervous over just one more enemy?
m930023.はは、頑張ってください。応援してますよ。: Haha, good luck. We're rooting for you.
m930023.ははぁ、それはまこと重畳にて。\nでは、お任せしていただけますかな:
Hahaha, that is most reassuring.
Then may I leave this in your capable hands?
m930023.ふざけるなよ……おい、ふざけるな！ おいっ！: Don't be ridiculous…… Hey, don't be ridiculous! Hey!
m930023.ふむ、そう呼ばれていた時期もありましたな。: Mm, I have been known by that name in times past.
m930023.へぇー、そういえば言ってたね？\n兵部卿になったんだ、おめでとう！: So, does that mean you won't die here today?
m930023.ぼくがちゃんとドウマン様に執り成してやるからさー！: I'm going to properly mediate with Lord Douman, so…!
m930023.ぼくだって兵部卿になったんだからな！？\nいつまでも昔のぼくと同じだと思うなよ！:
Oh, is that so? I do remember you mentioning that.
Congratulations on becoming the Minister of War!
m930023.まあ、これまでにもう六回ぐらい\n暗殺者を送られてるんですけどねー。: Well, they've sent assassins after us about six times already, though.
m930023.まあまあ、どうせ御上に使い潰されるのがオチでしたよ。: Now, now. You were going to be used up and discarded by the lord anyway.
m930023.もうよい、言い訳の前に足を使え。\n貴様の代わりはいくらでもいることを忘れるな。:
Enough. Use your legs before you start making excuses.
Don't forget that I can replace you with anyone.
m930023.もしかしたら和解の道も見つかるかもしれない。: Maybe we can find a path to reconciliation.
m930023.もしもドウマンを倒せなければ、\nこの国が再び群雄割拠の時代に戻り、\nまた戦で:
If we fail to defeat Douman,
this country will fall back into an age of warring states,
and thousands more will lose their lives in war.
m930023.や、その、なんか、普通に帰れちゃったっていうか──: U-um, well, I guess I just came home like it was nothing……
m930023.やば、今回の元凶じゃん。\n検非違使ー！ 検非違使ー！\nここに事件の犯人がいま:
Yikes, she's the ringleader this time.
Kembitui! Kembitui!
The culprit of the incident is right here!
m930023.よく来てくれたな、ヨシノ。\n急な呼び出し、訝しく思うたことだろう。:
You've come, Yoshino.
I imagine this sudden summons raised some eyebrows.
m930023.よし、これで全員無事に帰還できたね。\nみんな朝廷がどんな状況か把握できたろう。:
Good, everyone is back safely.
I assume you all have a grasp of the court's current situation.
We need to discuss our strategy against Douman.
m930023.よしよし、それじゃあ帰んべ帰んべ。: Alright, alright. Let's head home, shall we?
m930023.よーし、全員武器下ろして―。: Lady Yoshino, I take full responsibility for this as your steward—
m930023.キシシ、見事なものよなぁ。: Kishiishi, that was quite the spectacle.
m930023.シズカ、見事だった。お前の勝ちだよ、武器を捨てろ。: Shizuka, well done. You've won. Put down your weapon.
m930023.セイメイさんが表に出てくれたら良いのでは？: Wouldn't it be better if you went out in public, Seimei?
m930023.セイメイよ、地獄で見ているか？\n貴様が育てたこの国、儂が壊してくれようぞ。:
Seimei, are you watching from hell?
Let me shatter this nation you nurtured.
m930023.チェルシーちゃん偉い！ 百年無税！: Good job, Chelsea! You're exempt from taxes for a hundred years!
m930023.ドウマン様！？ どうしてこちらに！: Lord Douman!? Why are you here!
m930023.ヨシノ、汝には知る限りの情報を吐いてもらおう。: Yoshino, you will surrender all the information you possess.
m930023.ヨシノ殿よ、ここは逆に考えられてはどうだ？\n風神雷神、ぬらりひょん、酒呑童子、:
Lady Yoshino, perhaps you should look at it from the other side?
Fujin, Raijin, Nurarihyon, Shuten-doji, Ootakemaru…
m930023.一気に捕まえるわよ！: Master! We're running out of time!
m930023.三人で遊んだのが懐かしいわね！: I miss the days when we three played together!
m930023.事前に結界を張っておいたので、\n音は外部に漏れていないはずです。\n師匠の術に:
I set up a barrier beforehand, so
the sound shouldn't have leaked outside.
It's not as good as Master's techniques, though──
m930023.人質になってあの子の足を引っ張るぐらいなら、\n此処で一人でも多く道連れにして死:
Rather than becoming a hostage and holding that girl back,
I'll take as many of you down with me as I can and die here.
m930023.今から対式神の陣法を授ける、一晩で覚えなさい。: I will now teach you the formation for countering shikigami. Memorize it by tonight.
m930023.今から徹夜で準備だよ、トホホ……。: So I'm going to be working all night to get ready. Ugh……
m930023.今まで武家の盾に隠れていたうらなり風情が、\n帝の権勢を笠に着た途端に強者面とは:
You who hid behind the warrior class's shield,
the moment you wield the Emperor's authority, you act like the strong? How laughable!
m930023.今回は初心者さんたちもいるからねー、\n前提の共有はこまめにやっとかないと。: We've got some newbies with us, so I need to make sure everyone's on the same page.
m930023.今後一週間の帝やドウマンの予定に関連するもの。\nとりあえず手当たり次第にね、内:
Anything related to the Emperor's or Douman's schedule for the next week.
We'll grab everything we can find. I'll sort through the contents myself.
m930023.似たような存在にいくつか心当たりがあるのよ。: I know a few beings of a similar nature.
m930023.何の権利があって帝の決定に異を唱えるのか。\nいかに物質界の盟主とて道理というも:
On what grounds do you dare challenge the Emperor's decision?
Even if you are the leader of the Material World, there is a limit to reason.
I will not bow to the threats of the Kingdom's military might and prestige.
m930023.何をしたらそんなに恨まれるんですか……？: What did you do to make him hate you that much……?
m930023.何をしておるノリモチ、早う行かぬか。: What are you doing, Norimochi? Hurry up!
m930023.何を驚く、先の芸神例祭を忘れたわけではなかろう。\nそなたらの挺身なくては朕の命:
Why the shock? You haven't forgotten the recent Geishin Festival, I hope.
Without your efforts, my life would have been in grave danger.
I can no longer stand by while they pose such a threat.
m930023.儂は譲歩した、それ以上は内政干渉と見做す。: I have made a concession. Anything more I will view as interference in our internal affairs.
m930023.先代国主の娘って……。: The daughter of the former Lord…
m930023.公家文化に憧れるのは結構ですけどね、\n腹芸のできない殿には朝廷は無理です。:
It's all well and good to admire courtly culture, but
the imperial court is no place for a lord who can't read the room.
m930023.共存、なるほど確かに理想的な未来ではある。\nしかし、その過程で犠牲になる民草は:
Coexistence. I suppose it is an idealistic future.
But how many commoners will be sacrificed in the process?
The capital was attacked, and the Emperor's safety was threatened. That is a fact.
m930023.兵部卿、儂はヨシノを殺せと言うたはずよのぅ？\nそれがなにを、侍一匹にここまで手:
Minister of War, I told you to kill Yoshino.
And what have you done? Struggling against a single samurai.
m930023.出たよ、武家の裏切り者が。\n美味しそうな名前しやがって、\n焼いて醤油に浸して:
So the traitor of the warrior class has shown his face.
What a delicious-sounding name.
I wonder if I should roast you up and dip you in soy sauce.
m930023.別に、私はノリモチのこと結構好きだもん。\n今時珍しいよ、あれだけ裏表がない大名:
Wanting to rise in rank for the sake of his beloved subordinates and people...
It's impressive that he can say that while sober.
m930023.勅命とあらば、参上するまでにございます。: If it is an imperial command, then I am duty-bound to appear.
m930023.君は先代の娘だぞ。: You are the former Lord's daughter.
m930023.問われて名乗るもおこがましいが！: It would be presumptuous to state my name when asked!
m930023.国主を狙え！ 武家の棟梁を殺せ！: Aim for the ruler! Kill the head of the warrior class!
m930023.夜中に大内裏へ忍び込むなんて、バレたら打ち首ね。: Sneaking into the Imperial Palace in the middle of the night…… if we get caught, we'll be beheaded.
m930023.大丈夫大丈夫、武家で面倒見てあげるからねー。: It's fine, it's fine. We'll take care of them as warriors should.
m930023.大好きな部下や領民のために出世したいとか、\nあれを素面で言えるんだから大したも:
Becoming Douman's lapdog is infuriating, though.
I'm reflecting on the fact that I failed to discipline him properly.
m930023.大妖と呼ばれる存在でもなければ抵抗は難しいだろう。\nつまり、あいつは式神だけの:
Unless they are great yokai, resistance would be nearly impossible.
In other words, he intends to build an army composed entirely of shikigami.
m930023.大師匠ぅ、私も行けますよぉ？: Grand Master, I can keep going too?
m930023.大罪だ、逆賊だ、ぼくはもう終わりなんだぁ……。: High treason, sedition…… I'm done for……
m930023.大義の御旗がドウマン側にある以上、\n国を守り続けたきみたち武家であっても、\n:
As long as the banner of righteousness is on Douman's side,
even you warriors, who have defended the nation,
will find it difficult to win the people's support.
m930023.大義を圧倒的武力で踏み潰すか、\n帝の側に控えるドウマンを除くか。:
We either crush the opposing "righteous" force with overwhelming military power,
or we eliminate Douman, who stands at the Emperor's side.
m930023.妖怪の中には我ら王国の友人も多くいます。\n彼らは世界を救うために共に戦った同胞:
Many of the yokai are friends of our Kingdom.
They are comrades who fought alongside us to save the world.
They should not be subjected to baseless persecution.
m930023.妖怪総大将か……儂も話には聞いておる。\nだが、その名にどれほどの意味があると言:
The General of the Yokai, is it… I've heard the rumors.
But what weight does that name actually carry?
m930023.存外、虎の器であったか。見くびっておったわ。\n気骨のある武士を手にかけるのは忍:
She has more spirit than I expected. I underestimated her.
It pains me to strike down a warrior of such backbone, but──
m930023.実はな、朕は近日中に諸国へと宣旨を下すつもりだ。\nこの国に蔓延る妖怪ども、その:
In fact, I intend to issue an imperial decree to all the provinces soon.
I will order the total annihilation of the yokai that have overrun this land.
m930023.実は今朝方に朝廷から呼び出しを受けてね。\n罠だとは思うけど、一応は話してみるつ:
Actually, we received a summons from the court this morning.
I suspect it's a trap, but I intend to go and talk to them just in case.
m930023.将を射んとする者はまず馬を射よってね。\n東の国を式神が支配する国にしようだって:
To shoot the general, first shoot the horse.
They want to turn the Eastern Kingdom into a nation ruled by shikigami?
m930023.少しの間だけでも情報を撹乱できるだけで上々だよ。: Even if it only throws off their information gathering for a little while, that's a win in my book.
m930023.帝に逆らう逆賊を捕らえよ！: Seize the rebels who defy the Emperor!
m930023.式神って、ミコトさんたちが使役している……。: Shikigami, like the ones Mikoto and the others command…
m930023.強引に連れ出しておいてなんだけど、\nそういうわけで王子たちは宿で留守番を──:
I know I'm dragging you along against your will,
but that's why the Princes will stay behind at the inn──
m930023.当然ながらそんなことになれば、\n陰陽師による恐怖政治の始まりだ。:
Naturally, if that comes to pass,
it will mark the beginning of a reign of terror by the onmyoji.
m930023.彼奴らが揃って死に絶えた今この時代こそが、\n我が国から妖怪を掃討するまたとない:
Now that they are all dead, this is the perfect opportunity
to purge yokai from our land.
m930023.恐れながら帝、確かに妖怪は危険な存在です。\nですが、我らの仇敵である大妖はすで:
With all due respect, Your Majesty, yokai are indeed a dangerous presence.
However, the Great Yokai who were our enemies have already passed on,
and the General of the Yokai desires coexistence with humans.
m930023.悪いけど、まだドウマンに生存を知られたくないんだよ。\nあいつ、私が生きてると知:
I'm sorry, but I still don't want Douman to know I'm alive.
If he finds out, he might just blow up the capital along with himself.
m930023.悪かったわよ、ほんと……ただいま。: You're a jerk, you know that…… I'm home.
m930023.我こそは先代国主が一人娘、シズカなり！\n武名惜しまぬ者、功を望む者はかかって参:
I am Shizuka, the only daughter of the former Lord of the Nation!
Those who regret their martial prowess, or those who seek glory, come at me!
Take my head and make it the deed of your lifetime!
m930023.我らに帝に背く意思などあろうはずもありません。: We have no intention of defying the Emperor.
m930023.手の空いた者も参加しなさい。\n式神相手の訓練にはなるだろう。:
Those who are free should join in.
It will serve as training against shikigami.
m930023.抜けば玉散る氷の刃、名をムラサメ──: When drawn, my ice blade scatters like jewels. My name is Murasame──
m930023.故郷に対する気持ちは妖怪とて同じです。\nシノさんに、ヨユキさん、鬼刃姫さんたち:
A youkai's feelings for their homeland are the same.
Shino, Yuyuki, and the Oni Blade Princess…
I'm sure none of them would run away either.
m930023.旧友に情でも湧いたか、くだらん真似を。: Did you feel some old friendship stirring? What a pointless act.
m930023.木っ端大名だった貴様を拾い上げてやったのは誰だ？\nよくも儂の期待を裏切り、斯様:
Who was it who picked you up when you were nothing but a minor lord?
And yet you betray my trust and put on such a wretched display.
m930023.正直なところ私としては大賛成なのですが～、\n現実問題ドウマンをどうやって暗殺す:
Honestly, I'm all for it, but~
how exactly do we assassinate Douman?
m930023.死にかけの公家と朝廷風情が調子に乗りやがってそんなに戦争\nがしたいならやってや: A half-dead courtier and the rest of the imperial court getting all cocky. If you want a war so badly, then have it! You spineless cowards who always hide behind the samurai, and the moment the Emperor returns, you pull this crap?
m930023.死屍累々ですね……。: The bodies are piled up everywhere……
m930023.殺さない程度に眠らせて、処理はチヨメがする。: We'll put them to sleep without killing them. Chiyome will handle the rest.
m930023.殿、落ち着いて。: My lord, please keep your composure.
m930023.殿ぉー、そろそろ限界でーす！:
Hold on! I'll break through this!
Take this, my ultimate Kickball Shot!
m930023.殿が口で負けた！: What can you do? He's a cowardly fool.
m930023.汝が妖怪総大将とやらと通じている以上は、\n先日の一件も偶然では片付けられぬから:
Since you are in contact with this so-called General of the Yokai,
the recent incident cannot be dismissed as a mere coincidence, can it?
m930023.治能力もないくせに喧嘩売ってそれで云十年前に島流しになっ\nたの覚えてないのかよ: You don't have the strength or the leadership to back it up, yet you're picking a fight. Do you not remember being exiled to an island ten years ago? What do you think you're doing, ruining the peace I worked so hard to build? I don't care anymore. Go ahead and kill each other──
m930023.無論、これは貴殿ら武家の功績に他ならぬ。: Of course, this is a testament to the achievements of your warrior class.
m930023.王国で仕入れた直近三刻の記憶が飛ぶ魔法の針です。\nそして現場にお酒の徳利やおつ:
It's a memory-erasing needle I sourced from the Kingdom. It wipes out the last three hours of memory.
After that, I scatter a sake flask and some snacks around the scene, and then just do a little this, that, and the other to make it look natural, and──
m930023.王国を裏から支配したいアンナさんは王子を洗脳し、\nアンジェラさんやアリシアさん:
Lady Anna, who wants to control the Kingdom from the shadows, is brainwashing the Prince.
She's trying to poach Lady Angela and Lady Alicia to her side while eliminating Lady Meireu, who stands in her way!
m930023.理想は大事だが、現実は待ってくれない。\nなに、いざとなれば汚名は全て私が被ると:
Ideals are important, but reality doesn't wait.
Don't worry. If it comes to that, I'll take all the blame myself.
m930023.生き方を教わる前に死んじゃったのよ、あの人。: She died before she could teach me how to live.
m930023.生まれはたたら場、火床の上がり！\n腰に佩かれて諸国を巡り、浮世を歩みし幾歳月。:
Born in a foundry, raised by the forge's heat!
Belted at my waist, I have wandered the provinces for countless years.
I cut down evil in the East and sever demons in the West.
m930023.百の節目を越えてより、年も数えぬ浪人暮らし。\n銭はなけれど心は錆びず、毀れぬ仁:
I've been a wandering samurai for over a hundred years, long since I stopped counting.
I may have no coin in my pocket, but my heart is free of rust,
and I carry an unbroken code of honor.
m930023.知ってるぞ、姫侍だ！: I know her! She's the Princess Warrior!
m930023.私が殿を務める。その隙に離脱しなさい。: I will hold the line. Use the opening to break away.
m930023.私としては適当に理由を付けて断るべきだと思うがね。\nこれは虎穴に入らずんば虎子:
Personally, I think we should find a plausible excuse and refuse.
This isn't a case of "you don't get the tiger's cub without entering the tiger's lair."
m930023.私は、この国に暮らす人々の営みを守りたい。: I want to protect the lives of the people living in this country.
m930023.私はそんなことしません！: I would never do such a thing!
m930023.立っているのもやっとのようだけど。: You barely seem able to stand.
m930023.端的に言うと東の国は現在内戦まで秒読みの状況でね。\n魔物の復活によって棚上げさ:
To put it simply, the Eastern Kingdom is on the brink of civil war.
The conflict between the warrior class and the aristocracy, which had been shelved due to the resurgence of monsters, is flaring up again now that the Western Capital is being rebuilt and the Emperor is returning.
m930023.結局ね、私の器は侍大将止まり。\n前線に立つ以外に能のない武骨者よ。\nそれに比:
In the end, my limit is Grand General of the Samurai.
I'm a roughneck who can do nothing but stand on the front lines.
Compared to you, who has studied governance well.
m930023.行くよシズカ！ コマちゃんは私が守る！: Let's go, Shizuka! I'll protect Komachan!
m930023.見事な啖呵にござった、シズカ殿。\nやはりもののふとはそうでなくては。:
A splendid declaration, Lady Shizuka.
A true warrior must be just like that.
m930023.言い訳は後で聞く、さっさと終わらせよ。: Save your excuses for later. Let's end this quickly.
m930023.話し合いで解決とかは……？: What about trying to resolve this through negotiation...?
m930023.説教なら死んだ後に聞くわよ、行きなさい！: If you want to lecture me, do it after I'm dead. Go!
m930023.誰のために学んだと思ってる！！: Who do you think I studied for!!
m930023.貴様ら、何をして──: You there, what do you think you're doing──
m930023.逃がすな！ 捕らえろ！: Don't let them escape! Capture them!
m930023.逃げられた、か。この雨では足跡も追えぬ。: So we've lost them. In this rain, there are no tracks to follow.
m930023.逃げ足だけは速いもんなァ！？ よっ、野生児！: Do you hate me!? Or are you loyal!?
m930023.遠からん者は音にも聞け！ 近くば寄って目にも見よ！: If you are near, hear my voice! Come close and see me with your own eyes!
m930023.酔って大喧嘩になり全員気絶した宴会場の完成です。: And just like that, we've got a banquet hall where everyone got drunk and started a huge brawl and passed out.
m930023.非礼はお詫びします。しかし、どうかご再考を。: I apologize for the impertinence. But please, reconsider.
m930023.馬鹿殿ォ！ 公家にかぶれてっからそうなんだ！: You're a nobody! You can't kill enemies with Kickball!
m930023.馬鹿言え、さっきまでそんな気配──: Don't be absurd, there was no sign of that just now──
m930023.（あれが帝……なんだか、随分と幼いような……）: (That's the Emperor… He looks surprisingly young…)
m930023.（ここからどうしようかねぇ、完全にしくじっちゃったし。\nせめてシズカと王子だけ:
(What do I do from here? We've completely botched this.
At the very least, I need to get Shizuka and the Prince out unscathed──)
m930023.（これじゃあ本当に死んじゃうよぉ！？）: (I'm really going to die here, aren't I?!)
m930023.（ふぃー、最近は夜も少し冷えますねぇ……）: (Phew, it's getting a little chilly at night lately……)
m930023.（まあよい、これで武家と朝廷の対立は決定的──）: (Very well. This makes the conflict between the military and the court absolute──)
m930023.（また面妖なのが現れたのぉ。\n王国の手の者か、それとも──）:
(Another odd one shows up.
Are they working for the Kingdom, or……)
m930023.（まったく、公家は根性なしが多くて嫌になるのぅ……）: (Honestly, the nobility are all spineless. It's disgusting……)
m930023.（よく言うよ……全部自分の仕込みのくせに）: (How dare you… You set all of this up yourself)
m930023.（キシシ、なんとも簡単な遊戯よなぁ……！）: (Hehehe, what a simple game this is……!)
m930023.（セイメイ大師匠直々の稽古、\n人死にが出る程とは聞いていたけれどぉ……！）:
(I heard Grand Master Seimei's personal training
could be deadly, but this is…!)
m930023.（喋っちゃ駄目よ、目を付けられるわ）: (Don't say a word. We don't want to draw attention to ourselves.)
m930023.（帝が儂の手にある以上、大義は常にこちらにある）: (As long as the Emperor is in my hands, the righteous cause is always on our side.)
m930023.（帝ではなくドウマン様だってさ……どっちが主なんだか）: (Not the Emperor, but "Lord Douman"… I wonder who the real master is here.)
m930023.（彼奴らを朝敵に認定し、\n逆賊の汚名を着せてやれば、\nこちらに寝返る者も増え:
(Once I brand them as enemies of the state
and slap the label of "rebel" on them,
more will surely come over to our side.)
m930023.（笑わないとやってられないこともあるのよ): (Sometimes, you just have to laugh to keep going.)
